title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Hunter ABCs
description:
As you may have guessed,
I'm here to instruct you.
Good to see you studying
the Quest Info. No matter
what the Quest, you'll find
vital hints for clearing it
here. Be sure to consult the
guide every chance you get.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ BBQ Basics
description:
It's your trusty instructor
once again. The Quest Info
column is jam-packed with
important info such as the
contract fee needed to take
on a Quest, the reward for
completing a Quest, your
objectives, and the time
limit.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Hunter Gathering
description:
Here's another lesson from
your favorite instructor.
Kudos for checking here.
No matter what the Quest,
be sure to check here.
On this Quest, you'll be
hunting for Honey. Find
a beehive, and it's as
good as yours!

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Combining Basics
description:
All set for today's lesson?
Now, every item has a fixed
combining success rate. If
at first you don't succeed,
try, try again! Open the
menu with {K010}, select
Combos and then Combo List
to view a list of recipes.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Fishing Fundamentals
description:
You guessed it -- it's your
one and only instructor!
Now, the fish inhabiting
Fishing Points differ in
each location, so remember
where to net the fish you
need. The type of fish also
changes with the season. Ah,
the wonder of mother nature!

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Sword School
description:
Now listen up, 'cos this is
important! You need to bag
5 Velociprey to clear this
Quest. Once you get the hang
of handling your weapon,
it's time to hone your
hunting skills. Keep your
eyes peeled for blue scales!

description:

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Stolen Egg Scramble
description:
我輩だ。教官だ！
卵を持っているときに攻撃を
受けると、卵は割れてしまう
のだ。{K073}{K080}{K068}{K069}を使って視点
を動かし、周囲に気を配れ！
さらに、スタミナが切れても
落っことしてしまうからな！

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Basic Hunting
description:
Time for a real hunt!
Make good use of the items
supplied, and give it your
all! Once you're adept at
slaying your prey, study the
art of monster capture in
order to diversify your
hunting options.

title: <Sleep Training> Dreamy Weapon Practice
description:
ご主人様〜
頑張ってるかミャ〜
夢なら体力は減らないから、
本能の赴くままに練習が
できるミャ〜
時間は１５分だミャ〜
飽きたら≪キャンプマーク≫
に向かうんだミャ〜
すぐに起こしてあげるミャ〜
successCondition:
Practice until time expires,
or practice till tired

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Taking the Bait
description:
The goal this time round
is to catch some Pin Tuna.
It's a good idea to start
by tracking down some bait.
Tell you what! Collect some
Unique Mushrooms and I'll
supply you with some!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Bug Hunt
description:
The goal for this training
exercise is to slay a swarm
of Vespoids in the Jungle.
If taking them out one by
one proves tricky, try using
Poison Smoke Bombs instead.
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Stop the Desert Stampede
description:
The aim this time is to slay
some Cephalos rampaging the
rampage in the Desert. The
key to a high score is to
skillfully force them to
the surface when they're
swimming in the sand.
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Herbivore Egg Harvest
description:
Your goal is to snatch some
nourishing Herbivore Eggs.
Now, the road to the eggs
is a long one. but who
knows--maybe you'll chance
upon some eggs abandoned
by others for whom the Quest
proved too much...
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ The Queen of the Jungle
description:
On this hunting excursion,
your goal is to bag the
Queen of the Jungle -- the
Rathian. You can clear the
Subquest to receive Supply
Items or make your own. The
choice is yours. Good luck
out there!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Hunting-A-Go-Go!
description:
I hope you've packed your
thermals, 'cos your goal is
to slay the Giaprey from the
Arctic Ridge. Now here's the
thing... There don't seem to
be any Giaprey around.
Where could they be hiding?
They're out there somewhere,
I swear...
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ A Giant Rock...that Moves!?
description:
A Daimyo Hermitaur has built
a nest in the Desert oasis,
and I need you to slay it.
It seems the area is overrun
with Hermitaurs, so watch
yourself. Don't be afraid to
turn tail and run if you're
surrounded.
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ The Coveted Carnivore Egg
description:
Culinary connoisseurs swear
by Carnivore Eggs, and your
next task is to deliver one.
Mmmm... Just imagine that
lip-smacking flavor with a
glass of fine wine. I can
almost taste it now... Huh!?
No, it's not for me! ...Ha!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Two Big Beasts Sighted
description:
There's a Bulldrome wreaking
havoc in the Arctic Ridge,
and guess whose job it is to
stop it? Yup! And there's
more... Reports speak of a
Blangonga in the area! Well,
you didn't expect this job
to be easy, did you?
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Velocidrome Face-Off
description:
Our main event in the Arena
today is hunter versus beast
in a duel to the death! Your
opponent? The one and only,
Velocidrome! Well, two of
them, to be exact. But it
should be a cinch for a
hunter of your prowess.
Now, go get 'em!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Kut-Ku Face-Off
description:
Our main event in the Arena
today is hunter versus beast
in a duel to the death! Your
opponent this time is a Yian
Kut-Ku. Don't let the cute
name fool you -- it's a
flying wyvern, not a cuckoo.
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Rathian Face-Off
description:
Our main event in the Arena
today is Hunter versus beast
in a duel to the death! Your
opponent this time is a
Rathian. It won't be an easy
ride, but if you prevail...
you'll come out the other
side a full-fledged hunter.
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Shogun Face-Off
description:
Our main event in the Arena
today is Hunter versus beast
in a duel to the death! Your
opponent this time is a
Shogun Ceanataur. Be careful
not to get chopped to bits
by its scythe-like claws!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Kirin Face-Off
description:
It's time for our final
event in the Arena, so I've
prepared a special opponent
for you. Behold, a Kirin!
Not a bad choice, if I do
say so myself. Now get out
there and make me proud!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ I Demand Herbivore Eggs!
description:
The goal of this exercise is
to snatch some nourishing
Herbivore Eggs. Or that's
what's written here, anyway.
Well, that's basic Hunter
training for ya', hun.
C'mon! Those eggs aren't
going to gather themselves!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Stampeding Bulls!?
description:
It says here that your goal
in this training exercise
is to slay the Bullfangos
rampaging round the swamp.
It sounds so simple that
I could do it in my sleep. 
...But I'll leave it to you!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Into the Inferno
description:
So, according to this note,
your goal this time is to
comb the Desert for the coal
that is only obtainable in
the volcanic regions. Ha!
Knowing that Instructor, he
probably hid his own coal
collection in the sand!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Gourmet Grumbling
description:
An acquaintance of mine is
an incredible glutton...I
mean, gourmet! Now, he tells
me that nothing beats Rare
Steak. Can't see it myself,
but I'll take his word for
it. Good luck finding some,
anyway. Hope it's not as
"rare" as it sounds! Ha ha!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Revenge of the Coal!
description:
The Instructor told me he
wants to use the Coal left
over from the other day for
more training. I guess it's
good to recycle. And it's
best to go along with his
little whims if it's in
the name of training.
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Happy Hunting
description:
At long last: The big one!
The gateway to glory! The
Slay of the Century! Prove
you've a cut above the rest,
that you've got the right
stuff, that you're the real
hunting deal! Don't let me
down, you hear?
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Hunt the Swamp Hooligan
description:
It says here that your goal
this time is to hunt down
the Congalala devouring all
the swamp's mushrooms. That
bumbling beasty has given
me heaps of trouble too, so
take that critter out!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Snowy Slay Ride
description:
Slaying 20 Anteka, eh?
Seems that Instructor of
yours has come up with an
easy-peasy one for you.
Still, you'll earn special
points for fetching those
Carnivore Eggs, so it's got
to be worth a shot!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Hunting Training≫ Guild Trial
description:
Well, well! Looks like you
have yourself a trial from
the Guild! Now's your chance
to show them how much you've
learned since you first hit
town. Think of it as a final
exam, and do your best.
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Velocidrome Face-Off
description:
In this Arena challenge,
it's hunter versus beast
in a no-holds-barred duel
to the death!
This time, your opponents
are Velocidromes. Show 'em
what you've got and beat 'em
to a pulp!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Gypceros Face-Off
description:
In this Arena challenge,
it's hunter versus beast
in a no-holds-barred duel
to the death! This time,
it appears your opponent
is a Gypceros. Strike its
crown with all your might!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Rathian Face-Off
description:
In this Arena challenge,
it's hunter versus beast
in a no-holds-barred duel
to the death! This time,
your opponent is the
infamous Rathian. Avoid
its fire and strike its
crown with everything
you've got!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Shogun Face-Off
description:
In this Arena challenge,
it's hunter versus beast
in a no-holds-barred duel
to the death! This time,
your opponent is the Shogun
Ceanataur. Take care not
to be cut to shreds by
its scythe-like pincers!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Battle Training≫ Double Diablo Duel
description:
It's time for your farewell
bout in the Arena! And your
final opponents are... not
one, but two Diablos! This
will be your toughest test
yet. Be sure to watch their
movements carefully!
failCondition:
Faint even once,
or time expires

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Know Your Surroundings
description:
Aim to bring back 8 of the
Unique Mushrooms that grow
in the Jungle. You'll also
be rewarded for delivering
the Royal Rhinos sometimes
seen flying there. But start
by acquainting yourself with
the big, bad Jungle.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Velocidrome Territory
description:
The Velocidrome will flee to
a different area and lay low
to recover its health. While
it may be the perfect foe to
measure your hunting skills
against, its minions -- the
Velociprey -- are out in
force so be careful.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Velocidrome Territory
description:
Take down the Velocidrome
feeding in the Jungle. It's
the perfect foe to measure
your hunting skills against.
And you won't find many of
its minions, the Velociprey,
around during this season,
so now's your chance!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, the mighty
leader of the Bullfangos,
makes regular appearances
in the Jungle. It's a tough
opponent, so using items
like a Shock Trap to catch
it instead of killing it
could be a good plan.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, leader of
the Bullfangos, is a tough
customer on an old-fashioned
rampage. This cold weather
has made him ravenous, no
doubt. If things get out of
hand, why not just catch and
deliver the Goldenfish?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. If
you manage to hunt one, you
can consider yourself quite
the skilled hunter. Make a
sound by its ears and it may
shed some tears...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Blue Yian Kut-Ku Sighted
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. A
Yian Kut-Ku normally has a
pink body, but this one is
rumored to be blue. Could be
an intriguing subspecies...

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
You'll be quite the Hunter
if you succeed in bagging
the Yian Kut-Ku! If you have
a free moment, you can even
try ripening some mushrooms!
Just put a Unique Mushroom
into a Maka Pot and bury it
in the ground! Easy, right?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Daimyo of the Shore
description:
It's said the Daimyo emerges
on the shore at this time of
year. Its body is protected
by a hard carapace, making
damaging it difficult. You
can get Carapaceon Brains
from his minions.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
The Congalala is a Fanged
Beast with a fondness for
fungus, a taste shared by
its minions, the Congas.
If you'd like to make its
acquaintance, try stocking
up on Unique Mushrooms.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
Don't let the Congalala's
odd behavior throw you. You
may think it's preparing to
chow down during battle,
only to find it flying into
a tantrum, or even pooping
on you. Don't be alarmed,
that's just how it marks
its turf...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Queen's Domain
description:
Countless hunters have bowed
before the Rathian, which is
how it earned the nickname
of "Queen of the Land". Hunt
down this regal beast, and
you'll prove yourself once
and for all to be a true
hunter.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Pink Rathian
description:
So it turns out there's a
Rathian subspecies -- a
regal beast with a pink
body and a foul temper. For
this battle, you'll need to
gauge how you measure up to
your foe and decide whether
to capture or slay it.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Queen's Domain
description:
Announce your arrival on the
hunting scene by hunting the
Rathian. She isn't called a
Queen for nothing. If you
don't feel up to the task,
try snatching some Wyvern
Eggs instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Leaping Lizards
description:
The Desert is aswarm with
Genprey, led by the bulky,
razor-clawed Gendrome.
Should hunting this beast
prove a problem, focus on
getting a Blooming Cactus
by placing a Cactus Flower
in a Maka Pot instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Leaping Lizards
description:
The Guild is seeking hunters
to track down the fearsome
Gendrome. And if you've got
spare time, 'tis the season
for Herbivore Eggs. These
nourishing eggs are firm
favorites of merchants and
gourmets everywhere.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Swimming Sand Wyverns
description:
Hunting the Cephalos that
swim freely through the
sand isn't easy. Battling
their boss, the Cephadrome,
will take every ounce of
perseverance you have. You
need to lure it to the
surface with a loud noise
or shock.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Corpse Collector
description:
The Daimyo Hermitaur can
usually be found burrowing
under the sand, so keep
this in mind if you plan
on hunting it. When the
Daimyo holds its guard, it
can be nigh on impregnable.
They don't call it the
"Shield Crab" for nothing.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Underwater Jade
description:
This is the season when a
Plesioth subspecies with a
striking jade body is known
to appear in the Desert.
Hunting it is no easy task,
and you'll need to make a
loud noise to draw it from
the water.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Lurking in the Deep
description:
It's highly probable that
the Plesioth is hunting
prey by the waterside. When
fishing out a Plesioth with
a Frog, the fewer hunters
involved, the better. If
others are with you, get
them to leave the area,
and face the beast alone.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Sakura
description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Battle with Brutality
description:
The Diablos's viciousness
sets it apart from most
Desert dwellers. Get on
the wrong end of its
charge, and it may be the
last mistake you make.
Breaking its horns can
also bring victory.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Black Horns
description:
A Diablos has been sighted,
its black body striking any
who see it dumb with horror.
There is believed to be only
one, so any capable hunter
should be able to deal with
it. But if you take victory
for granted, you may be in
for a rude awakening.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Ioprey are stirring, and
it may well mean that their
leader, the Iodrome, is in
the vicinity. A direct hit
from its venomous spit could
prove fatal, so don't forget
to pack plenty of antidotal
items.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Iodrome's devastating
blows leave the Velocidrome
and Gendrome in the shade.
If you sense danger, focus
on gathering the mushrooms
found in the swamp instead.
You could also try maturing
them in a Maka Pot.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Reckless Razorback
description:
The swamp's the environment
best-suited to Bullfangos.
For those hunters planning
to face the Bulldrome, we
ask that you also slay as
many Bullfangos as possible.
Needless to say, a reward
will be provided.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
A ferocious, flapping
beast with a nasty line
in venomous spit, it's
not a complete birdbrain,
and can play dead when it
feels threatened.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Purple Peril
description:
A Gypceros subspecies has
appeared in the swamp, and
its body is apparently an
eerie shade of purple. It
has a habit of collecting
shiny objects, so you may
be rewarded with a precious
stone if you manage to
break its crown.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
It boasts not only a nasty
line in toxic spit, but can
also fire deadly beams of
light. Word is that smashing
its crown can put an end to
its little light show.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Queen of the Swamp
description:
All hunters know that if you
bag yourself a Rathian, you
can hold your head high as
the real deal. Just think of
the respect you'd earn if
you could reduce this regal
beast to tears! Maybe you'd
have to pluck a nose hair...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
While the Daimyo has strong
defense, the Shogun excels
in offense. A single slice
from its claws can shred all
before it. If hunting it
proves too tough, destroy
its claws and flee.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur's
vicious, razor-sharp claws
have earned it the nickname
of the "Scythe Crab." In
other news, Sootstone Ore
can be mined in the Swamp
this season, so if you're
lucky you could get a
Lightcrystal as a reward.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
This is the season when the
Marshlands teem with Congas.
Their leader, Congalala, is
something of a lone wolf and
is so mighty, it doesn't
need to run with the rest of
the pack. Exercise extreme
caution.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
If you are hit by the dung
Congalala throws, then you
will become unable to use
recovery items. If hunting
it proves difficult, trade
the Khezu Whelps in the
ground with the Veggie Elder
and deliver what he gives
you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Hunting in an Arctic Land
description:
Don't forget to pack some
Hot Drinks before heading
to the Arctic Ridge. Why
not get acclimatized to the
frosty slopes by slaying
Popos before taking on the
Bulldrome?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Red Shadow
description:
A red shadow's been sighted
slithering through the snow.
It's sure to be a Red Khezu.
The Blangos are searching
for food together in packs,
so take care not to run into
both beasts together.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The White Shadow
description:
Khezu spend their larval
stage entirely underground,
so their sense of smell is
believed to be superior to
their eyesight. If the hunt
runs into trouble, trade the
Khezu Whelps in the ground
with the Veggie Elder and
deliver what he gives you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
The Arctic Ridge is overrun
with countless Blango this
season. Acting on the orders
of their leader, Blangonga,
they attack in packs. Don't
let them surround you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Blangonga is the ruler of
the Arctic Ridge, and will
attack anyone who strays
onto its turf. Also, a rare
breed of Velociprey has come
in order to nest. They won't
want you touching their
eggs...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Hunting the Iodrome in the
Volcano may well prove to
be a headache. When its
health is low, it has a
nasty habit of fleeing to
an inhospitable spot where
your health will be drained.
The trick is to not to let
it escape.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
If you plan to go after the
Basarios, keep a careful eye
on the rocky regions, since
it will often try to blend
into the terrain. If your
mind is set on mining, then
be sure to gather some Coal.
It's an excellent energy
source.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
The Basarios eats ore to
grow, so its outer shell
can often contain the stuff.
Destroy its body parts and
you may save yourself the
trouble of having to mine.
Two stones, one bird!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Infernal Overlord
description:
Owing to a diet heavy in
ore and coal, the Gravios
boasts an incredibly hard
outer shell that takes
seriously robust weapons to
penetrate. If you're not
having any luck, you can
always try sneaking some
Powderstones instead...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ A Subspecies Clad in Black
description:
A Black Gravios, stained by
volcanic smoke and ash, has
appeared. One look at it
will make your blood curdle.
Still, if it's just a wyvern
encased in armor, surely
you just need to smash that
armor...

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. Should
you have trouble with the
hunt, try focusing on the
Remobra to get valuable
food ingredients instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. This is
also the season when you'll
find large numbers of young
Ceanataurs in the Volcano.
Beware of their sharp claws.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Know Your Surroundings
description:
Aim to bring back 8 of the
Unique Mushrooms that grow
in the Jungle. You'll also
be rewarded for delivering
the Royal Rhinos sometimes
seen flying there. But start
by acquainting yourself with
the big, bad Jungle.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The White Shadow
description:
The terrifying white shadow
seen crawling through the
darkness has been identified
as a Khezu. If you plan to
hunt it, keep one eye on the
sky, as the Khezu excels at
stealth attacks from above.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

successCondition:

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Blue Hunters of the Jungle
description:
Flex your hunting muscles,
and aim to take out 8 of
the Velociprey that feed
in the Jungle. They make
perfect foes for measuring
your hunting skills.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Ruffian Justice
description:
The Jungle's a rough place,
and the Bullfango are some
of the roughest, toughest
customers around. Exercise
extreme caution--it's cold,
and they're liable to be
hungry and quick to anger!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Wind-breaking Beasts
description:
If a dyspeptic Conga breaks
wind in your direction, you
will be rendered incapable
of using healing items. Be
sure to have Deodorant on
hand to neutralize the odor
right away.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

description:
Hermitaurs burrow into the
sand and then pop up without
warning, so don't run around
like a headless chicken.
They can be stunned by loud
noises, so don't forget to
stock up on Sonic Bombs.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

description:
Sadly, there's never a
shortage of Bullfango at
this time of year, and
they never fail to wreak
plentiful havoc. The Guild
calls on all civic-minded
hunters to put an end to
their rampage.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

need to lure it to the
surface with a loud noise
or shock.
successCondition:

measure your hunting skills.
successCondition:

Genprey in the shade.
successCondition:

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Mining Matters
description:
For any hunter interested in
ore-based weaponry, mining's
a skill you can't afford to
do without. The first step
is to identify areas that
can be mined. If you find a
crack in a cliff or ridge,
swing that Iron Pickaxe!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Basic Bug Hunting
description:
Bugs that inhabit hunting
grounds can be used in the
production or enhancement of
weaponry and armor, and for
combining. If you find bugs
buzzing around, take out a
a Bug Net and swing it to
bag them!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Fishing Foundation
description:
Fish dwelling in the hunting
grounds are essential for
combining ammunition. Get a
feel for fishing so that you
can keep a cool head when
you need to cast out a line.
Time it so you reel in the
fish the instant the float
sinks.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Transportation Tutorial
description:
Spring is in the air, and
it's the perfect time to
gather monster eggs. Your
mission is to deliver some
Carnivore Eggs. These are
relatively easy to carry,
but you'll need to be wary
of monster attacks, and your
stamina being worn down.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Master the Flash Bomb
description:
You'll have nothing to fear
once you've mastered the art
of flinging a Flash Bomb in
front of a monster's eyes
and blinding them with a
powerful flash of light.
Flash Bombs can be found in
the Supply Box, so feel free
to use them at will.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Master the Shock Trap
description:
Set a Shock Trap or Pitfall
Trap under a monster to stop
it in its tracks. Or you can
target a monster when it's
weak, put it to sleep with a
Tranq Bomb and capture it.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Velocidrome Territory
description:
The Velocidrome will flee to
a different area and lay low
to recover its health. While
it may be the perfect foe to
measure your hunting skills
against, its minions -- the
Velociprey -- are out in
force so be careful.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Twin Blue Shadows
description:
Hunt the two Velocidromes
feeding in the Jungle. They
make ideal foes to get you
in the hunting mood. It's
a perfect time to take them
on, as their minions, the
Velociprey, are thin on the
ground this season.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, the mighty
leader of the Bullfangos,
makes regular appearances
in the Jungle. It's a tough
opponent, so using items
like a Shock Trap to catch
it instead of killing it
could be a good plan.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, leader of
the Bullfangos, is a tough
customer on an old-fashioned
rampage. This cold weather
has made him ravenous, no
doubt. If things get out of
hand, why not just catch and
deliver the Goldenfish?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. If
you manage to hunt one, you
can consider yourself quite
the skilled hunter. Make a
sound by its ears and it may
shed some tears…
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Blue Yian Kut-Ku Sighted
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. A
Yian Kut-Ku normally has a
pink body, but this one is
rumored to be blue. Could be
an intriguing subspecies...

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
You'll be quite the Hunter
if you succeed in bagging
the Yian Kut-Ku! If you have
a free moment, you can even
try ripening some mushrooms!
Just put a Unique Mushroom
into a Maka Pot and bury it
in the ground! Easy, right?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Daimyo of the Shore
description:
It's said the Daimyo emerges
on the shore at this time of
year. Its body is protected
by a hard carapace, making
damaging it difficult. You
can get Carapaceon Brains
from his minions.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Venomous Storm
description:
We are in something of a
pickle. Two Gypceros have
appeared in the Jungle, one
black, the other a purple
sub-species. Even normally
unflappable hunters are
balking at the thought of
taking them both on. Are
you up to the task?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
The Congalala is a Fanged
Beast with a fondness for
fungus, a taste shared by
its minions, the Congas.
If you'd like to make its
acquaintance, try stocking
up on Unique Mushrooms.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
Don't let the Congalala's
odd behavior throw you. You
may think it's preparing to
chow down during battle,
only to find it flying into
a tantrum, or even pooping
on you. Don't be alarmed,
that's just how it marks
its turf...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ What a Whopper!
description:
Word has reached us of two
piscines lurking beneath the
water near the Jungle. One
of them is said to striking
green scales. Is there any
brave soul ready to confirm
the rumors?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Queen's Domain
description:
Countless hunters have bowed
before the Rathian, which is
how it earned the nickname
of "Queen of the Land". Hunt
down this regal beast, and
you'll prove yourself once
and for all to be a true
hunter.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Royal Procession
description:
Royal visitors have arrived
in the Jungle, but this is
no cause for celebration.
Two monstrous Queens are
there, one clad in lustrous
green, one in vivid pink.
Who will dare to face them?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Queen's Domain
description:
Announce your arrival on the
hunting scene by hunting the
Rathian. She isn't called a
Queen for nothing. If you
don't feel up to the task,
try snatching some Wyvern
Eggs instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Leaping Lizards
description:
The Desert is aswarm with
Genprey, led by the bulky,
razor-clawed Gendrome.
Should hunting this beast
prove a problem, focus on
getting a Blooming Cactus
by placing a Cactus Flower
in a Maka Pot instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Leaping Lizards
description:
The Guild is seeking hunters
to track down the fearsome
Gendrome. And if you've got
spare time, 'tis the season
for Herbivore Eggs. These
nourishing eggs are firm
favorites of merchants and
gourmets everywhere.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Swimming Sand Wyverns
description:
Hunting the Cephalos that
swim freely through the
sand isn't easy. Battling
their boss, the Cephadrome,
will take every ounce of
perseverance you have. You
need to lure it to the
surface with a loud noise
or shock.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Dust Cloud Fortress
description:
If you're taking aim at the
Daimyo Hermitaur, bear in
mind that it's very fond of
burrowing beneath the sand.
When it hardens its defense,
it becomes nigh invincible.
They don't call it the
"Shield Crab" for nothing.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Underwater Jade
description:
This is the season when a
Plesioth subspecies with a
striking jade body is known
to appear in the Desert.
Hunting it is no easy task,
and you'll need to make a
loud noise to draw it from
the water.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Lurking in the Deep
description:
It's highly probable that
the Plesioth is hunting
prey by the waterside. When
fishing out a Plesioth with
a Frog, the fewer hunters
involved, the better. If
others are with you, get
them to leave the area,
and face the beast alone.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Sakura
description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Battle with Brutality
description:
The Diablos's viciousness
sets it apart from most
Desert dwellers. Get on
the wrong end of its
charge, and it may be the
last mistake you make.
Breaking its horns can
also bring victory.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Four Horns
description:
A vile and vicious Diablos
with a blackened body has
been spotted. And what's
worse, it has company. Does
any hunter dare to face two
pairs of murderous horns?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Ioprey are stirring, and
it may well mean that their
leader, the Iodrome, is in
the vicinity. A direct hit
from its venomous spit could
prove fatal, so don't forget
to pack plenty of antidotal
items.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Iodrome's devastating
blows leave the Velocidrome
and Gendrome in the shade.
If you sense danger, focus
on gathering the mushrooms
found in the swamp instead.
You could also try maturing
them in a Maka Pot.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Reckless Razorback
description:
The swamp's the environment
best-suited to Bullfangos.
For those hunters planning
to face the Bulldrome, we
ask that you also slay as
many Bullfangos as possible.
Needless to say, a reward
will be provided.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Avian Menaces
description:
We've received word of bird-
like cries echoing through
the Marshlands. The Yian Kut
-Ku is the likely culprit,
and there may be more than
one. This Quest is not for
the faint-hearted. But some
brave soul will step up,
right...?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
A ferocious, flapping
beast with a nasty line
in venomous spit, it's
not a complete birdbrain,
and can play dead when it
feels threatened.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Purple Peril
description:
A Gypceros subspecies has
appeared in the swamp, and
its body is apparently an
eerie shade of purple. It
has a habit of collecting
shiny objects, so you may
be rewarded with a precious
stone if you manage to
break its crown.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
It boasts not only a nasty
line in toxic spit, but can
also fire deadly beams of
light. Word is that smashing
its crown can put an end to
its little light show.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Cream & Crimson
description:
It seems two shadows have
been seen slithering in the
darkness. The white shadow
has been identified as a
Khezu, while the red one
as its subspecies. Hunters
who have the guts to face
this electric duo should
come to the Quest Counter!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Queen of the Swamp
description:
All hunters know that if you
bag yourself a Rathian, you
can hold your head high as
the real deal. Just think of
the respect you'd earn if
you could reduce this regal
beast to tears! Maybe you'd
have to pluck a nose hair...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
While the Daimyo has strong
defense, the Shogun excels
in offense. A single slice
from its claws can shred all
before it. If hunting it
proves too tough, destroy
its claws and flee.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur's
vicious, razor-sharp claws
have earned it the nickname
of the "Scythe Crab." In
other news, Sootstone Ore
can be mined in the Swamp
this season, so if you're
lucky you could get a
Lightcrystal as a reward.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
This is the season when the
Marshlands teem with Congas.
Their leader, Congalala, is
something of a lone wolf and
is so mighty, it doesn't
need to run with the rest of
the pack. Exercise extreme
caution.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
If you are hit by the dung
Congalala throws, then you
will become unable to use
recovery items. If hunting
it proves difficult, trade
the Khezu Whelps in the
ground with the Veggie Elder
and deliver what he gives
you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Double Trouble
description:
It seems the swamp has been
taken over by two Gravios,
brought by the desire for
ore. Are there any hunters
brave enough to face such
formidable foes?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Hunting in an Arctic Land
description:
Don't forget to pack some
Hot Drinks before heading
to the Arctic Ridge. Why
not get acclimatized to the
frosty slopes by slaying
Popos before taking on the
Bulldrome?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Red Shadow
description:
A red shadow's been sighted
slithering through the snow.
It's sure to be a Red Khezu.
The Blangos are searching
for food together in packs,
so take care not to run into
both beasts together.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The White Shadow
description:
Khezu spend their larval
stage entirely underground,
so their sense of smell is
believed to be superior to
their eyesight. If the hunt
runs into trouble, trade the
Khezu Whelps in the ground
with the Veggie Elder and
deliver what he gives you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
The Arctic Ridge is overrun
with countless Blango this
season. Acting on the orders
of their leader, Blangonga,
they attack in packs. Don't
let them surround you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ One Big Happy Family
description:
The Blangonga is the ruler
of the Arctic Ridge, and
will brutally attack anyone
who threatens its territory.
This may sound far-fetched,
but two of these beasts have
been sighted. Even so, are
you still up to the task?

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Golden Mane
description:
A frightful monster has been
sighted at the edge of the
arctic land. Its power is
said to be comparable only
to that of an elder dragon,
and its body gives off a
radiant golden glow. No
hunter has yet seen it and
lived to tell the tale...

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Hunting the Iodrome in the
Volcano may well prove to
be a headache. When its
health is low, it has a
nasty habit of fleeing to
an inhospitable spot where
your health will be drained.
The trick is to not to let
it escape.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
If you plan to go after the
Basarios, keep a careful eye
on the rocky regions, since
it will often try to blend
into the terrain. If your
mind is set on mining, then
be sure to gather some Coal.
It's an excellent energy
source.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
The Basarios eats ore to
grow, so its outer shell
can often contain the stuff.
Destroy its body parts and
you may save yourself the
trouble of having to mine.
Two stones, one bird!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Infernal Overlord
description:
Owing to a diet heavy in
ore and coal, the Gravios
boasts an incredibly hard
outer shell that takes
seriously robust weapons to
penetrate. If you're not
having any luck, you can
always try sneaking some
Powderstones instead...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ A Subspecies Clad in Black
description:
A Black Gravios, stained by
volcanic smoke and ash, has
appeared. One look at it
will make your blood curdle.
Still, if it's just a wyvern
encased in armor, surely
you just need to smash that
armor...

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Four Scythes
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its strange limbs to scale
walls right to the ceiling.
If you have trouble hunting
it, you should focus on
picking off the Remobra
flying near the craters
instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. This is
also the season when you'll
find large numbers of young
Ceanataurs in the Volcano.
Beware of their sharp claws.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Golden Mane
description:
A frightful monster has been
sighted at the edge of the
scorched land. Its power is
said to be comparable only
to that of an elder dragon,
and its body gives off a
radiant golden glow. No
hunter has yet seen it and
lived to tell the tale...

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The King's Domain
description:
The Verdant Hills are ruled
by a certain flying wyvern.
The one and only King of the
Skies, a paragon of might --
the Rathalos. Anyone able to
hunt it will be acclaimed as 
a true first-rate hunter.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The Azure Dragon's Roar
description:
We've confirmed reports of
an Azure Rathalos in the
Verdant Hills. Only a hunter
with the might of a dragon
could hope to stand up to
its ferocious force. We'd
love to see someone like
that in action...

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The King of the Skies
description:
The Verdant Hills are ruled
by a certain flying wyvern.
The one and only King of the
Skies, a paragon of might --
the Rathalos. Any who return
bearing eggs plucked from
its nest shall forever be
celebrated for their valor.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ The Wyverns' Den
description:
A pair of kings has been
spotted soaring over the
remote Ancient Tower. It
can only be accessed when
the climate is just right.
In other words, now is the
time!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Hunting Test≫ Defeat the Desert Daimyo!
description:
さらなる高みを目指す者よ！
オヌシの腕前を再度確認すべ
く、こちらで指定したモンス
ターを全て狩猟して貰うぞ！
名づけて≪公式狩猟試験≫！
今回は砂漠に潜む盾蟹たちを
狩り尽くすことじゃ！難敵と
なるが達成を信じておるぞ！

title: ≪Hunting Test≫ Hunt the Blango!
description:
さらなる高みを目指す者よ！
オヌシの腕前を再度確認すべ
く、こちらで指定したモンス
ターを全て狩猟して貰うぞ！
名づけて≪公式狩猟試験≫！
今回は極寒の地に群生する白
き獅子たちを狩猟するのじゃ！
囲まれぬよう注意じゃぞ！

title: ≪Urgent Request≫ Protect the Fortress!
description:
古龍観測士より、怪しげな龍
がとうとう砦に到達したとの
知らせが入った！
今回はこの龍の撃退を公式狩
猟試験とする！
砦に到達した謎の龍を全力で
撃退するのじゃ！砦の迎撃兵
器をしかと活用するがよいぞ！
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Minister's Urgent Request≫ 古塔の最古龍を沈めろ！
description:
謎多き狩猟地≪古塔≫にて、
山が動くとの奇妙な話が届い
ておる…。ワシの推測が的中
すれば、ちと厄介な事態にな
りそうなのじゃ。事態が暗転
する前にその真実を確かめ、
話が誠ならば討伐を頼むぞ！

title: ≪Minister's Urgent Request≫ Slay the Legendary Dragon!
description:
Extraordinary rumors sweep
the land. The black dragon
of legend stalks the skies
above Castle Schrade, a
remote outpost far beyond
Dundorma. This baleful beast
is the harbinger of utter
ruin for our world, and must
be slain forthwith.

title: ≪Fortress Defense≫ Repel the Lao-Shan Lung!
description:
The Fortress that serves
as the gateway to Dundorma
is under siege by a Lao-Shan
Lung. Use all the weaponry
you can lay your hands on
until it turns tail. Hunters
lacking firepower should
ride the back of the beast
to collect Dragon Stones.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,

upon Dundorman territory!
We have to stop it before
it's too late! Make use of
the weapons around the base
to repel the threat!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Know Your Surroundings
description:
Aim to bring back 8 of the
Unique Mushrooms that grow
in the Jungle. You'll also
be rewarded for delivering
the Royal Rhinos sometimes
seen flying there. But start
by acquainting yourself with
the big, bad Jungle.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Velocidrome Territory
description:
The Velocidrome will flee to
a different area and lay low
to recover its health. While
it may be the perfect foe to
measure your hunting skills
against, its minions -- the
Velociprey -- are out in
force so be careful.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Velocidrome Territory
description:
Take down the Velocidrome
feeding in the Jungle. It's
the perfect foe to measure
your hunting skills against.
And you won't find many of
its minions, the Velociprey,
around during this season,
so now's your chance!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, the mighty
leader of the Bullfangos,
makes regular appearances
in the Jungle. It's a tough
opponent, so using items
like a Shock Trap to catch
it instead of killing it
could be a good plan.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, leader of
the Bullfangos, is a tough
customer on an old-fashioned
rampage. This cold weather
has made him ravenous, no
doubt. If things get out of
hand, why not just catch and
deliver the Goldenfish?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. If
you manage to hunt one, you
can consider yourself quite
the skilled hunter. Make a
sound by its ears and it may
shed some tears…
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Blue Yian Kut-Ku Sighted
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. A
Yian Kut-Ku normally has a
pink body, but this one is
rumored to be blue. Could be
an intriguing subspecies...

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
You'll be quite the Hunter
if you succeed in bagging
the Yian Kut-Ku! If you have
a free moment, you can even
try ripening some mushrooms!
Just put a Unique Mushroom
into a Maka Pot and bury it
in the ground! Easy, right?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Daimyo of the Shore
description:
It's said the Daimyo emerges
on the shore at this time of
year. Its body is protected
by a hard carapace, making
damaging it difficult. You
can get Carapaceon Brains
from his minions.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
The Congalala is a Fanged
Beast with a fondness for
fungus, a taste shared by
its minions, the Congas.
If you'd like to make its
acquaintance, try stocking
up on Unique Mushrooms.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
Don't let the Congalala's
odd behavior throw you. You
may think it's preparing to
chow down during battle,
only to find it flying into
a tantrum, or even pooping
on you. Don't be alarmed,
that's just how it marks
its turf...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Queen's Domain
description:
Countless hunters have bowed
before the Rathian, which is
how it earned the nickname
of "Queen of the Land". Hunt
down this regal beast, and
you'll prove yourself once
and for all to be a true
hunter.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Pink Rathian
description:
So it turns out there's a
Rathian subspecies -- a
regal beast with a pink
body and a foul temper. For
this battle, you'll need to
gauge how you measure up to
your foe and decide whether
to capture or slay it.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Queen's Domain
description:
Announce your arrival on the
hunting scene by hunting the
Rathian. She isn't called a
Queen for nothing. If you
don't feel up to the task,
try snatching some Wyvern
Eggs instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Leaping Lizards
description:
The Desert is aswarm with
Genprey, led by the bulky,
razor-clawed Gendrome.
Should hunting this beast
prove a problem, focus on
getting a Blooming Cactus
by placing a Cactus Flower
in a Maka Pot instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Leaping Lizards
description:
The Guild is seeking hunters
to track down the fearsome
Gendrome. And if you've got
spare time, 'tis the season
for Herbivore Eggs. These
nourishing eggs are firm
favorites of merchants and
gourmets everywhere.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Swimming Sand Wyverns
description:
Hunting the Cephalos that
swim freely through the
sand isn't easy. Battling
their boss, the Cephadrome,
will take every ounce of
perseverance you have. You
need to lure it to the
surface with a loud noise
or shock.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Corpse Collector
description:
The Daimyo Hermitaur can
usually be found burrowing
under the sand, so keep
this in mind if you plan
on hunting it. When the
Daimyo holds its guard, it
can be nigh on impregnable.
They don't call it the
"Shield Crab" for nothing.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Underwater Jade
description:
This is the season when a
Plesioth subspecies with a
striking jade body is known
to appear in the Desert.
Hunting it is no easy task,
and you'll need to make a
loud noise to draw it from
the water.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Lurking in the Deep
description:
It's highly probable that
the Plesioth is hunting
prey by the waterside. When
fishing out a Plesioth with
a Frog, the fewer hunters
involved, the better. If
others are with you, get
them to leave the area,
and face the beast alone.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Sakura
description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Battle with Brutality
description:
The Diablos's viciousness
sets it apart from most
Desert dwellers. Get on
the wrong end of its
charge, and it may be the
last mistake you make.
Breaking its horns can
also bring victory.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Black Horns
description:
A Diablos has been sighted,
its black body striking any
who see it dumb with horror.
There is believed to be only
one, so any capable hunter
should be able to deal with
it. But if you take victory
for granted, you may be in
for a rude awakening.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Ioprey are stirring, and
it may well mean that their
leader, the Iodrome, is in
the vicinity. A direct hit
from its venomous spit could
prove fatal, so don't forget
to pack plenty of antidotal
items.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Iodrome's devastating
blows leave the Velocidrome
and Gendrome in the shade.
If you sense danger, focus
on gathering the mushrooms
found in the swamp instead.
You could also try maturing
them in a Maka Pot.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Reckless Razorback
description:
The swamp's the environment
best-suited to Bullfangos.
For those hunters planning
to face the Bulldrome, we
ask that you also slay as
many Bullfangos as possible.
Needless to say, a reward
will be provided.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
A ferocious, flapping
beast with a nasty line
in venomous spit, it's
not a complete birdbrain,
and can play dead when it
feels threatened.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Purple Peril
description:
A Gypceros subspecies has
appeared in the swamp, and
its body is apparently an
eerie shade of purple. It
has a habit of collecting
shiny objects, so you may
be rewarded with a precious
stone if you manage to
break its crown.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
It boasts not only a nasty
line in toxic spit, but can
also fire deadly beams of
light. Word is that smashing
its crown can put an end to
its little light show.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Queen of the Swamp
description:
All hunters know that if you
bag yourself a Rathian, you
can hold your head high as
the real deal. Just think of
the respect you'd earn if
you could reduce this regal
beast to tears! Maybe you'd
have to pluck a nose hair...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
While the Daimyo has strong
defense, the Shogun excels
in offense. A single slice
from its claws can shred all
before it. If hunting it
proves too tough, destroy
its claws and flee.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur's
vicious, razor-sharp claws
have earned it the nickname
of the "Scythe Crab." In
other news, Sootstone Ore
can be mined in the Swamp
this season, so if you're
lucky you could get a
Lightcrystal as a reward.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
This is the season when the
Marshlands teem with Congas.
Their leader, Congalala, is
something of a lone wolf and
is so mighty, it doesn't
need to run with the rest of
the pack. Exercise extreme
caution.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
If you are hit by the dung
Congalala throws, then you
will become unable to use
recovery items. If hunting
it proves difficult, trade
the Khezu Whelps in the
ground with the Veggie Elder
and deliver what he gives
you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Hunting in an Arctic Land
description:
Don't forget to pack some
Hot Drinks before heading
to the Arctic Ridge. Why
not get acclimatized to the
frosty slopes by slaying
Popos before taking on the
Bulldrome?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Red Shadow
description:
A red shadow's been sighted
slithering through the snow.
It's sure to be a Red Khezu.
The Blangos are searching
for food together in packs,
so take care not to run into
both beasts together.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The White Shadow
description:
Khezu spend their larval
stage entirely underground,
so their sense of smell is
believed to be superior to
their eyesight. If the hunt
runs into trouble, trade the
Khezu Whelps in the ground
with the Veggie Elder and
deliver what he gives you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
The Arctic Ridge is overrun
with countless Blango this
season. Acting on the orders
of their leader, Blangonga,
they attack in packs. Don't
let them surround you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Blangonga is the ruler of
the Arctic Ridge, and will
attack anyone who strays
onto its turf. Also, a rare
breed of Velociprey has come
in order to nest. They won't
want you touching their
eggs...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Hunting the Iodrome in the
Volcano may well prove to
be a headache. When its
health is low, it has a
nasty habit of fleeing to
an inhospitable spot where
your health will be drained.
The trick is to not to let
it escape.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
The Basarios eats ore to
grow, so its outer shell
can often contain the stuff.
Destroy its body parts and
you may save yourself the
trouble of having to mine.
Two stones, one bird!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

successCondition:

description:
Owing to a diet heavy in
ore and coal, the Gravios

outer shell that takes
seriously robust weapons to
penetrate. If you're not
having any luck, you can
always try sneaking some
Powderstones instead...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ A Subspecies Clad in Black
description:
A Black Gravios, stained by
volcanic smoke and ash, has
appeared. One look at it
will make your blood curdle.
Still, if it's just a wyvern
encased in armor, surely
you just need to smash that
armor...

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. Should
you have trouble with the
hunt, try focusing on the
Remobra to get valuable
food ingredients instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. This is

find large numbers of young
Ceanataurs in the Volcano.
Beware of their sharp claws.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

description:
Aim to bring back 8 of the
Unique Mushrooms that grow
in the Jungle. You'll also
be rewarded for delivering
the Royal Rhinos sometimes
seen flying there. But start
by acquainting yourself with
the big, bad Jungle.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

The Jungle's a rough place,

and they're liable to be
hungry and quick to anger!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

For any hunter interested in

do without. The first step
is to identify areas that
can be mined. If you find a
crack in a cliff or ridge,
swing that Iron Pickaxe!
successCondition:

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Basic Bug Hunting
description:
Bugs that inhabit hunting
grounds can be used in the
production or enhancement of
weaponry and armor, and for
combining. If you find bugs
buzzing around, take out a
a Bug Net and swing it to
bag them!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Fishing Foundation
description:
Fish dwelling in the hunting
grounds are essential for
combining ammunition. Get a
feel for fishing so that you
can keep a cool head when
you need to cast out a line.
Time it so you reel in the
fish the instant the float
sinks.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Transportation Tutorial
description:
Spring is in the air, and
it's the perfect time to
gather monster eggs. Your
mission is to deliver some
Carnivore Eggs. These are
relatively easy to carry,
but you'll need to be wary
of monster attacks, and your
stamina being worn down.
successCondition:

and blinding them with a

the Supply Box, so feel free

description:
The Velocidrome will flee to
a different area and lay low
to recover its health. While
it may be the perfect foe to
measure your hunting skills
against, its minions -- the
Velociprey -- are out in
force so be careful.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Twin Blue Shadows
description:
Hunt the two Velocidromes
feeding in the Jungle. They
make ideal foes to get you
in the hunting mood. It's
a perfect time to take them
on, as their minions, the
Velociprey, are thin on the
ground this season.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, the mighty
leader of the Bullfangos,
makes regular appearances
in the Jungle. It's a tough
opponent, so using items
like a Shock Trap to catch
it instead of killing it
could be a good plan.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bag the Boar Boss
description:
The Bulldrome, leader of
the Bullfangos, is a tough
customer on an old-fashioned
rampage. This cold weather
has made him ravenous, no
doubt. If things get out of
hand, why not just catch and
deliver the Goldenfish?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. If
you manage to hunt one, you
can consider yourself quite
the skilled hunter. Make a
sound by its ears and it may
shed some tears…
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Blue Yian Kut-Ku Sighted
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. A
Yian Kut-Ku normally has a
pink body, but this one is
rumored to be blue. Could be
an intriguing subspecies...

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
description:
You'll be quite the Hunter
if you succeed in bagging
the Yian Kut-Ku! If you have
a free moment, you can even
try ripening some mushrooms!
Just put a Unique Mushroom
into a Maka Pot and bury it
in the ground! Easy, right?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Daimyo of the Shore
description:
It's said the Daimyo emerges
on the shore at this time of
year. Its body is protected
by a hard carapace, making
damaging it difficult. You
can get Carapaceon Brains
from his minions.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Venomous Storm
description:
We are in something of a
pickle. Two Gypceros have
appeared in the Jungle, one
black, the other a purple
sub-species. Even normally
unflappable hunters are
balking at the thought of
taking them both on. Are
you up to the task?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
The Congalala is a Fanged
Beast with a fondness for
fungus, a taste shared by
its minions, the Congas.
If you'd like to make its
acquaintance, try stocking
up on Unique Mushrooms.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Congalala's Turf
description:
Don't let the Congalala's

may think it's preparing to
chow down during battle,
only to find it flying into
a tantrum, or even pooping
on you. Don't be alarmed,
that's just how it marks
its turf...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ What a Whopper!
description:
Word has reached us of two

green scales. Is there any

the rumors?
successCondition:

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Queen's Domain

of "Queen of the Land". Hunt

you'll prove yourself once
and for all to be a true
hunter.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

description:

green, one in vivid pink.
Who will dare to face them?
successCondition:

successCondition:
