title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Lurking in the Deep
description:
It's highly probable that
the Plesioth is hunting
prey by the waterside. When
fishing out a Plesioth with
a Frog, the fewer hunters
involved, the better. If
others are with you, get
them to leave the area,
and face the beast alone.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Sakura
description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Battle with Brutality
description:
The Diablos's viciousness
sets it apart from most
Desert dwellers. Get on
the wrong end of its
charge, and it may be the
last mistake you make.
Breaking its horns can
also bring victory.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Four Horns
description:
A vile and vicious Diablos
with a blackened body has
been spotted. And what's
worse, it has company. Does
any hunter dare to face two
pairs of murderous horns?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Ioprey are stirring, and
it may well mean that their
leader, the Iodrome, is in
the vicinity. A direct hit
from its venomous spit could
prove fatal, so don't forget
to pack plenty of antidotal
items.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Venom Ruler
description:
The Iodrome's devastating
blows leave the Velocidrome
and Gendrome in the shade.
If you sense danger, focus
on gathering the mushrooms
found in the swamp instead.
You could also try maturing
them in a Maka Pot.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Reckless Razorback
description:
The swamp's the environment
best-suited to Bullfangos.
For those hunters planning
to face the Bulldrome, we
ask that you also slay as
many Bullfangos as possible.
Needless to say, a reward
will be provided.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Avian Menaces
description:
We've received word of bird-
like cries echoing through
the Marshlands. The Yian Kut
-Ku is the likely culprit,
and there may be more than
one. This Quest is not for
the faint-hearted. But some
brave soul will step up,
right...?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
A ferocious, flapping
beast with a nasty line
in venomous spit, it's
not a complete birdbrain,
and can play dead when it
feels threatened.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Purple Peril
description:
A Gypceros subspecies has
appeared in the swamp, and
its body is apparently an
eerie shade of purple. It
has a habit of collecting
shiny objects, so you may
be rewarded with a precious
stone if you manage to
break its crown.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Toxic Threat
description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
It boasts not only a nasty
line in toxic spit, but can
also fire deadly beams of
light. Word is that smashing
its crown can put an end to
its little light show.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Cream & Crimson
description:
It seems two shadows have
been seen slithering in the
darkness. The white shadow
has been identified as a
Khezu, while the red one
as its subspecies. Hunters
who have the guts to face
this electric duo should
come to the Quest Counter!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Queen of the Swamp
description:
All hunters know that if you
bag yourself a Rathian, you
can hold your head high as
the real deal. Just think of
the respect you'd earn if
you could reduce this regal
beast to tears! Maybe you'd
have to pluck a nose hair...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
While the Daimyo has strong
defense, the Shogun excels
in offense. A single slice
from its claws can shred all
before it. If hunting it
proves too tough, destroy
its claws and flee.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Shogun Swamp Lurker
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur's
vicious, razor-sharp claws
have earned it the nickname
of the "Scythe Crab." In
other news, Sootstone Ore
can be mined in the Swamp
this season, so if you're
lucky you could get a
Lightcrystal as a reward.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
This is the season when the
Marshlands teem with Congas.
Their leader, Congalala, is
something of a lone wolf and
is so mighty, it doesn't
need to run with the rest of
the pack. Exercise extreme
caution.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
description:
If you are hit by the dung
Congalala throws, then you
will become unable to use
recovery items. If hunting
it proves difficult, trade
the Khezu Whelps in the
ground with the Veggie Elder
and deliver what he gives
you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Double Trouble
description:
It seems the swamp has been
taken over by two Gravios,
brought by the desire for
ore. Are there any hunters
brave enough to face such
formidable foes?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Hunting in an Arctic Land
description:
Don't forget to pack some
Hot Drinks before heading
to the Arctic Ridge. Why
not get acclimatized to the
frosty slopes by slaying
Popos before taking on the
Bulldrome?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Red Shadow
description:
A red shadow's been sighted
slithering through the snow.
It's sure to be a Red Khezu.
The Blangos are searching
for food together in packs,
so take care not to run into
both beasts together.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The White Shadow
description:
Khezu spend their larval
stage entirely underground,
so their sense of smell is
believed to be superior to
their eyesight. If the hunt
runs into trouble, trade the
Khezu Whelps in the ground
with the Veggie Elder and
deliver what he gives you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
The Arctic Ridge is overrun
with countless Blango this
season. Acting on the orders
of their leader, Blangonga,
they attack in packs. Don't
let them surround you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ One Big Happy Family
description:
The Blangonga is the ruler
of the Arctic Ridge, and
will brutally attack anyone
who threatens its territory.
This may sound far-fetched,
but two of these beasts have
been sighted. Even so, are
you still up to the task?

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Golden Mane
description:
A frightful monster has been
sighted at the edge of the
arctic land. Its power is
said to be comparable only
to that of an elder dragon,
and its body gives off a
radiant golden glow. No
hunter has yet seen it and
lived to tell the tale...

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Hunting the Iodrome in the
Volcano may well prove to
be a headache. When its
health is low, it has a
nasty habit of fleeing to
an inhospitable spot where
your health will be drained.
The trick is to not to let
it escape.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
If you plan to go after the
Basarios, keep a careful eye
on the rocky regions, since
it will often try to blend
into the terrain. If your
mind is set on mining, then
be sure to gather some Coal.
It's an excellent energy
source.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
The Basarios eats ore to
grow, so its outer shell
can often contain the stuff.
Destroy its body parts and
you may save yourself the
trouble of having to mine.
Two stones, one bird!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Infernal Overlord
description:
Owing to a diet heavy in
ore and coal, the Gravios
boasts an incredibly hard
outer shell that takes
seriously robust weapons to
penetrate. If you're not
having any luck, you can
always try sneaking some
Powderstones instead...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ A Subspecies Clad in Black
description:
A Black Gravios, stained by
volcanic smoke and ash, has
appeared. One look at it
will make your blood curdle.
Still, if it's just a wyvern
encased in armor, surely
you just need to smash that
armor...

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Four Scythes
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its strange limbs to scale
walls right to the ceiling.
If you have trouble hunting
it, you should focus on
picking off the Remobra
flying near the craters
instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. This is
also the season when you'll
find large numbers of young
Ceanataurs in the Volcano.
Beware of their sharp claws.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Golden Mane
description:
A frightful monster has been
sighted at the edge of the
scorched land. Its power is
said to be comparable only
to that of an elder dragon,
and its body gives off a
radiant golden glow. No
hunter has yet seen it and
lived to tell the tale...

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The King's Domain
description:
The Verdant Hills are ruled
by a certain flying wyvern.
The one and only King of the
Skies, a paragon of might --
the Rathalos. Anyone able to
hunt it will be acclaimed as 
a true first-rate hunter.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The Azure Dragon's Roar
description:
We've confirmed reports of
an Azure Rathalos in the
Verdant Hills. Only a hunter
with the might of a dragon
could hope to stand up to
its ferocious force. We'd
love to see someone like
that in action...

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The King of the Skies
description:
The Verdant Hills are ruled
by a certain flying wyvern.
The one and only King of the
Skies, a paragon of might --
the Rathalos. Any who return
bearing eggs plucked from
its nest shall forever be
celebrated for their valor.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ The Wyverns' Den
description:
A pair of kings has been
spotted soaring over the
remote Ancient Tower. It
can only be accessed when
the climate is just right.
In other words, now is the
time!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Thunderous Might
description:
Lightning strikes of an
unprecedented scale have
been witnessed near the
Ancient Tower. We'd like
to call on only the most
elite hunters to go out
and investigate.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Mighty Tempest
description:
We've received reports of
a violent sandstorm in the
Desert. We'd like to call
on only the most skilled
hunters to investigate
and eliminate its source.
Be advised, we are unable
to provide any supplies.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Mighty Blaze
description:
We've received reports of
a raging wildfire in the
Marshlands. It is thought
to be the work of an Elder
Dragon. We'd like you to
investigate immediately.
We cannot provide any
supplies, but we hope for
your safe return.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Karmic Mist
description:
One of our best hunters
was brought back severely
wounded after a nightly
expedition to the swamp.
We've received no reports
of any dangerous monsters,
and yet... You've got to
head to the Marshlands and
figure out the cause!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Proud Empress
description:
A disaster has struck!
The Empress herself has
returned... This is an
extremely urgent matter.
We cannot send more than
one person to the Tower.
Is there any brave soul
up to the task?

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Proud Empress (Repel)
description:
We'd like you to deal with
the Lunastra. Ideally you
should slay it, but if that
proves too difficult, you
may repel it. Keep in mind
however, that depending on
your performance we may or
may not reward you with a
slaying certificate.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Mighty Assault
description:
The Fortress is under attack
by a Lao Shan-Lung! Use the
weapons around the fort to
repel it! If that proves too
difficult, at least try to
harvest the medicinal stones
from its back!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Floating Mountain
description:
A Yama Tsukami has arrived.
And it's said to be covered
by a red aura, too... We'd
like to send you to the
Ancient Tower to investigate
this abnormality. Note that
you may only stay for half
the usual time.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Mighty Advance
description:
A mysterious monster is
approaching the Fortress
at a tremendous pace! Use
the weapons around the fort
to repel it! If that proves
too difficult, at least try
to wound its legs!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Thunderous Arrival
description:
We've discovered a powerful
Belkuros in the Canyon. Due
to the dangerous nature of
this request, we cannot
provide any supplies. That
being said, successfully
completing the Quest will
reward you with numerous
rare materials. Good luck!

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Stormcaller's Den
description:
Up until now, the Belkuros
was thought to live only in
the Canyon. And yet now an
extremely powerful specimen
has been spotted around the
Ancient Tower. The area is
extremely dangerous, and we
cannot provide any supplies.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Mighty Craving
description:
Reports of an especially
old Pariapuria have come up.
Rumor has it that it's been
alive for many, many years.
Who knows just how much it
has eaten during then?
You won't need any supplies
...right?

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Mighty Dash
description:
We've received reports of a
pair of powerful Orugarons
wreaking havoc in the swamp.
We'll provide a special set
of supplies to aid you in
the hunt. Please, head to
the Marshlands and save the
day!

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Bitterly Cold Showdown
description:
Have you ever heard of the
secret part of the Ancient
Tower? Well, an extremely
powerful Duragaua has been
spotted there. Our lack of
knowledge about it makes
this a particularly scary
request. Only hunters who
have proven themselves may
take on this assignment.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Shivering Stalker
description:
The Duragaua has migrated.
Up until now, it had only
been spotted at the Tower
and Highlands, but now it
has turned the Canyon into
its new home, making it a
highly adaptable monster.
This specimen is reported
to be extremely powerful.
Steel yourself, hunters.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Draguros Whiplash
description:
A flying wyvern known as the
Draguros has been spotted in
the Arctic Ridge.
It is reported to be one of
the strongest of its kind.
Only the most elite hunters
may take on this Quest.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Fallen Angel
description:
The Draguros, previously
discovered in the Ridge,
has now been sighted atop
the Highlands. What's worse,
it is thought to be one of
the strongest of its kind.
Only the most elite hunters
may take on this Quest.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Barbaric Beatdown
description:
We've received reports
of a Grenzebul thought
to be the strongest of
its kind. This Quest is
extremely dangerous, so
only the most esteemed
hunters may initiate it.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Operation Magnetbreaker
description:
A powerful Rukodiora is en
route to Mezeporta Square.
The Interception Base is
armed and ready. Now is the
time to show your worth as
a hunter. Make use of the
weapons around the fort to
dispatch the threat.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Polar Polka
description:
We've spotted a Rukodiora
in the Desert. Unlike the
Interception Base, there
are no tools to counter it.
We are looking for elite
hunters to neutralize the
threat. Remember that the
Desert heat is unrelenting,
even during Winter!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Castle from the Sands
description:
Countless hunters have been
wounded trying to learn more
about the Odibataurus. It's
still one big mystery, but
we hope you can carry on the
investigation. Watch out for
its deadly sand attacks!

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Leaping Scarlet Beast
description:
The elusive Gogomoa has been
spotted at the Tidal Island.
What's more, it is reported
to be an extremely powerful
individual. We still have
much to learn about it, so
watch yourself out there.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ A Shadow Bathed in Twilight
description:
We've spotted an extremely
powerful Gogomoa. Not only
that, there have also been
numerous reports about a
surge in insect activity
in the area. This won't be
an easy hunt. Be careful.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Lord of the Abyss
description:
We've received an emergency
message from the researchers
stationed near the Tidal
Island. Their reports speak
of an extremely powerful
Taikun Zamuza lurking in the
caves below. Please, save
them before it's too late!

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Misty Investigation
description:
Word has reached me about a
powerful elder dragon headed
for the Marshlands. Can you
break its parts and hunt it
for me? What about a reward?
Uh, let's see... I think I
still have some materials
left over from my research
into Elder Dragon Wings...

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Menace of the Marshlands
description:
An abnormally aggressive
Abiorg has been spotted
in the Marshlands. This
recently discovered monster
is extremely dangerous, so
only the most elite hunters
may take on this Quest.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Arctic Aggressor
description:
An abnormally aggressive
Abiorg has been spotted
in the Arctic Ridge.
This Quest is extremely
dangerous and can only
be accepted by approved
hunters. Take all the
necessary precautions.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Disastrous Duo
description:
The ferocious Abiorg has
been spotted in the Great
Forest. Witness reports
state that several roars
could be heard in the area.
It's almost like it was
communicating... There may
be more than one of them
present. Stay cautious.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Brute Dyed in Crimson
description:
According to a new report,
the fearsome Abiorg has been
spotted in the Jungle. One
of the witnesses reported
seeing numerous tracks and
hearing roars from multiple
directions. There may be
more than one in the area.
Exercise caution.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Through Storm and Fury
description:
The recently discovered
monster has been confirmed
to be a leviathan, known
as the Quarzeps. It seems
to be one of the strongest
of its kind. The Guild is
worried about the research
team's safety. Head to the
locale and secure the area.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ A Shine Piercing the Storm
description:
We have received reports of
a powerful Quarzeps atop the
Great Forest. Its ability to
absorb and reflect lightning
make it a highly dangerous
opponent. Steel yourselves,
hunters.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Dazzling Duo
description:
A pair of Quarzeps has been
spotted in the Desert. One
of the researchers claims to
have felt violent tremors in
from the ground. The details
are unknown, but there is no
time to make any inquiries.
Head out and investigate.

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Desert Barrage
description:
A mysterious, scarlet-hued
monster has appeared in the
Desert. Reports speak of its
colossal size and tremendous
strength. We're dealing with
an unknown threat here, so
go out and investigate!

title: ≪Test of Might≫ Test of Might: Plesioth
description:
We've prepared a special
Quest for those wanting
to obtain Mighty Tickets.
While not particularly
difficult, there is one
catch: You must use an
SP Weapon. Ready? Then
go out and hunt!
successCondition:
Slay the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Gendrome Attack!
description:
It looks like an especially
powerful Gendrome is going
out of its way to terrorize
hunters. It may prove to be
a formidable foe, but the
rewards will more than make
up for it.

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Cephadrome Attack!
description:
A powerful Cephadrome has
appeared. Any hunters who
can take it down will be
rewarded with a hefty sum.
However, please be advised
that other rewards will be
limited.

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Velocidrome Attack!
description:
A powerful Velocidrome has
appeared. Any hunters who
can take it down will be
rewarded with a hefty sum.
However, please be advised
that other rewards will be
limited.

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Gypceros Attack!
description:
We've received an unusual
report about a pair of
Gypceros rampaging through
the Jungle. The Guild is
urgently looking for able-
bodied hunters ready to
neutralize the threat!

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Bulldrome Attack!
description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time you'll be up against
the bane of all villages,
the infamous Bulldrome!
But that's not all! A herd
of Bullfango has also been
unleashed into the Arena!
Will you stand against
their tusked fury, or die
trying!?

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Hypnocatrice Attack!
description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time you'll be up against a
pair of Hypnocatrice! Can
YOU weave your way through
their sleep-inducing gas
and deliver the finishing
blow? Gold and glory awaits
you! Step right up!

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Fanged Beast Attack!
description:
Welcome to the Arena!
Representing the fanged
beasts: Blangonga and
Congalala! The two are
deadly enough on their own,
but paired together!? Is
anyone capable of taking
down these beasts!? Even
one slip up could cost
your life! Step right up!

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Basarios Attack!
description:
An especially fierce pair
of monsters -- a Basarios,
together with a Gravios,
has shown up. The Guild is
urgently looking for able-
bodied hunters ready to
neutralize the threat!

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Diablos Attack!
description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time, following a request
from the Elder Hall, we've
unleashed an exceptionally
powerful Diablos into the
Arena! Who among you shall
slay this mighty beast and
break the bank!? Step right
up!

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Rathalos Attack!
description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time you're up against a
pair of Rathalos! Who will
live to tell the tale of
this fiery feud!? The King
of the Skies? Or the King of
the Hunt? Step right up!

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Plesioth Attack!
description:
I've received reports of
a giant Plesioth in the
Desert. A beast this size
simply must be fished out,
so make sure to do that
before anything. You will
be handsomely rewarded.
What's that? Don't feel
like fishing? No way!
That won't fly.

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Gravios Attack!
description:
It seems the swamp has been
taken over by two Gravios,
brought by the desire for
ore. Are there any hunters
brave enough to face such
formidable foes?

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Rajang Attack!
description:
This time you're up against
a... I mean -- THE Rajang!
And two of them at that!
Who among you shall slay
these Golden Beasts and
break the bank!? Step right
up!

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Aberrant Lavasioth Attack!
description:
An exceptionally powerful
Lavasioth has been spotted
at the Volcano. It is known
by some as the "Lord of the
Volcano". Such a towering
figure... How could anyone
hope to defy it!? Oh... if
only there was a legendary
hunter, capable of ending
its reign...
successCondition:
Slay the target monster, and
damage the specified parts

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Aberrant Rajang Attack!
description:
This time you're up against
a pair of shadows. In the
red corner: The Dark Wolf
-- Yian Garuga! And in the
blue corner -- The Golden
Lion, Rajang! Who among you
shall slay the two Aberrant
savages and claim the
bounty!?

title: ≪Special Quest≫ Grenzebul Assault!
description:
You there, youngster. How
about a little hunt? Your
target will be slightly
larger, and maybe a little
stronger than usual. What's
the reward? Not much, but it
should be a good learning
experience.

hands on a material said to
be infused with their very
soul...

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Cruel Couple
description:

is rampaging through the
Desert! Not only are they
stronger, but their horns
seem to be even more brutal
than usual. It certainly
won't be easy, but if one
were to get their hands on
them... In any case, please
deal with them!
successCondition:

or Subquest A

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ URGENT: Sweepers Needed!
description:
近ごろ、雪山に猪が大量に
発生していてケガ人が続出し
ています。ハンターズギルド
は、この≪ドスファンゴ≫を
中心とした群れを退治してく
ださる方々を募集しておりま
す。事態は深刻のため、
報酬も一部のハンターが垂涎
する貴重な素材になります。

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Dark Wooden Bow
description:
失われた名弓「黒弓」を知っ
ているか？その素材を持って
いるが、タダではやらないよ。
火山に棲みつく黒鎧竜を弓で
狩猟してくれれば、キミの実
力を認めて、この≪墨のカケ
ラ≫を差し上げよう。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Upgrade
description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う
孤独な狩り。
以前に渡した設計図を工房の
親方に手渡してハンマーを
作ったと思うが、実はさらに
強化することができるのじゃ！
改良したければ、白銀の秘壺
３３個を持ってくるがよい。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Master Miner's Challenge
description:
ほう、ワシの依頼を
受けてくれるというのか。
採掘名人への道は険しいぞ？
それでは、貴重な鉱石２種を
大量に集めてもらおうかの。
そうすれば交換で、秘蔵の
鉱石をくれてやろう。
秘蔵の鉱石を集めれば
集めるほど、オヌシは
採掘名人に近づくじゃろう。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Ancient Dragonbone Bow
description:
発掘で石を発見したんじゃが、
これでは価値が見出せん！
そこでハンターであるお主に
ゆびきり草を集めて欲しい。
ゆびきり草を束にすることで、
石を磨くことができるんじゃ。
持ってきてくれれば、
余った石をわけてやるぞい。

title: ≪Note Quest≫ Boron: Blue Yian Kut-Ku
description:
Ancient notes about crafting
techniques, believed to have
been lost to time, have been
found on monsters in various
locales! If you happen to
get your hands on one, bring
it to me at once! I'll show
you what a real man can do!

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Bird-brained Beatdown
description:
Aim for the head, strike,
strike, and strike again!
Those are the fundamentals
of hunting. If you want to
get your hands on this rare
bone, take my beloved gear
and bash some birds in!

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Arctic Ridge Lost & Found
description:
One of the veteran hunters
was descending the Arctic
Ridge, when he was attacked
by a dangerous monster. He
dropped everything and made
a run for it. I was asked to
recover his stuff, but...
Look, help me out and I'll
share some of it with you.
Do we have a deal?

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Mystery of the Lost Ruins
description:
I've heard this rumor about
ancient ruins hidden in the
Marshlands. I went to go and
check them out myself, but
an Aqra Jebia stood in my
way. Think y'could get rid
of it for me? I'll give ya'
a part of the artifacts I
find as thanks.

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Flaming Thornsword
description:
So, I've spotted a Flaming
Espinas at the Tower. It
looked pretty ordinary, but
I sensed something special
from its horns, spikes, and
certain scales... Reckon if
ya' hunt it down, we might
be able to get our hands on
some unique materials...

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Pearl Thornsword
description:
So, I've spotted a Pearl
Espinas at the top of the
Great Forest. It looked
ordinary, but I sensed
something special from its
horns, spikes, and certain
scales... Reckon if ya' hunt
it down, we might be able to
get our hands on some unique
materials...

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Ultimate Thornsword
description:
The sword you've forged
is far from reaching its
true potential. Complete
this Quest to get your
hands on the "Stout Thorn"
and awaken its latent
power.
successCondition:
Slay the target monster, and
damage the specified part

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Argenite Sword & Shield
description:
Looking for a one-handed
Sword? I've got you! Ever
heard of Argenite? Just one
thing... The ore used to
make it is incredibly rare,
and its usually surrounded
by some nasty monsters.
Do your best and I'll take
it from there!

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Argenite Dual Blades
description:

I've got you! Ever heard of

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Black Bastion
description:
A pair of old Black Gravios
has appeared in the swamp.
Considering their age and
huge bodies... They could
probably devour all the ore
in the area! Is there any
brave soul ready to take
them out?

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ The Secret of the Raths
description:
I have studied the Raths for
many years, and my research
is all but complete. Now all
that's left for me to do, is
to study the Aberrant ones!
With that my book will be
ready! I need you to capture
both of them for me. If you
do, I'll gift you a copy.

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Sandy Surprise
description:
You want my flute? Hmm...
I can't just give it away
for some trinkets... See,
there's some folks out in
the Desert that have real
beef with that flute. The
scar on my face, too. Tell
you what: If you manage to
hunt them down, I might
just give it away.
successCondition:
Hunt one of the target
monsters

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ A Battle on Two Fronts
description:
I've been working on telling
the tale of a most wonderful
melody I'd heard in a far
away land, but recently I
have inherited a mysterious
stone. I don't think I'm
worthy of it, however...
If you complete the Quest,
I'll award you with both the
stone and the melody.

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ The Rookie Carver's Trial
description:
My master says that a REAL
carver SHOULD be able to
carve a Gravios's tailbone
with his eyes closed... And
now he wants me to show him
one. Can you capture and
sever an Aberrant Gravios's
tail? I'll carve the bone,
show it to my master, and
then give it to you.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster and
damage the specified part

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Lava Dancers
description:
The sight of living beings
fighting for their lives...
What a thrill! How about
this -- Head to the Volcano
and hunt down a Shogun
Ceanataur. I shall reward
you with a precious, jeweled
egg. They say that there's a
fanged beast in the area,
but you can leave it be...

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Wild Dark Dancers
description:
I came to visit the Canyon,
hoping to admire its many
breathtaking views, but all
I saw was a bunch of brutal
monsters. I believe they are
known around here as the
Yian Garuga and Rajang?
I had no choice but to come
back... Please get rid of
these menaces!

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ The Red Guard
description:
A certain traveler really
wants to visit the Jungle.
According to their servant,
the place is swarming with
Daimyo Hermitaur, and they
want them gone. Apparently
they're offering a special
reward... Interested?

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Blue with a Hint of Blue
description:
Ah, right, that painting the
Guild ordered... Yes, yes,
of course. All that's left
is the Velocipreys. Oh, if
only anyone was willing to
help me capture their raw
ferocity... I'm sure the
Guild would reward them
handsomely...

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Seeing Blue
description:
Ah, right, that painting the
Guild ordered... Yes, yes,
of course. All that's left
is the Velocipreys. Oh, if
only anyone was willing to
help me capture their raw
ferocity... I'm sure the
Guild would reward them
handsomely...

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ The Hymn of the Hills
description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
second part...
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Honest Hammering
description:
What, you want this piece
of junk? It says something
about upgrading armor. I
could do it, but not for a
wimp like you... How bout'
ya get some more experience
first. Forging's all about
fire, a bit of clink, and a
whole lotta clang. Got it?
successCondition:
Hunt one of the target
monsters

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Proof of Patience
description:
Stunning medallion, right?
If you work hard, you too
can make something like it.
Patience is a virtue for
artisans and hunters alike.
If you can show me just how
patient you really are, it's
all yours.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Pink & Poisonous Peril
description:
An Aberrant Gypceros and
Congalala seem to be causing
quite the ruckus around the
Jungle. Please hunt them as
soon as possible. You will
be rewarded with a special
emblem provided to us by
the Guild.

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Verdant Hills Reprisal
description:
I was out gathering in the
Verdant Hills, when a pair
of Rathalos attacked! I've
saved my skin, but I can't
just stand by and let them
wreak havoc. Can you handle
it? I'll give ya' a Sturdy
Jawbone in return.

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Dark Wolf, Dark Stars
description:
I saw it! A bona fide meteor
shower! You may be able to
find traces of them around
the Jungle. I hear there's
a Garuga in the area though,
so be careful!
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Desert Crown
description:
I was ambushed by a color-
shifting scorpion! What's
worse, I dropped my precious
book... If you've got the
time, could you please look
for it? Still, the crystals
on that critter were one-of-
a-kind. I'd love to add some
to my costume...
successCondition:
Slay the Aqra Vashim and
hunt the Gendrome

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Feathered Flurry
description:
樹海で珍しい蒼色の眠鳥たち
が発見されたそうじゃな。
あいつらは昼の間、泣き叫ん
でうるさくてかなわん。
そこで相談じゃが、あいつを
討伐してきてくれんか？
お礼は「青色の羽毛」じゃ。
クチバシも壊してくれると、
さらにスカッとするのう。

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ All Fired Up!
description:
Hey, you love the Gunlance
don't you? I'll tell 'ya
something good. Now, don't
be shy! A Silver Rathalos's
been spotted at the Tower.
And my hunch tells me it'd
make an awesome Gunlance!
Go out there and blast away!
Show the King how it's done!

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Ancient Dark Bow
description:
In order to bring out the
great Dark Bow's power, it
must be treated with Ancient
Ink, which I just so happen
to have. I will not do it
for free, however. Prove
your worth by hunting an
Akantor with the Bow, and
I'll gladly help you.

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Nature's Chorus: Desert
description:
I can hear it. The ocean's
roar, the wind's howl, the
forest's hush. But can you?
Complete this Quest to get
your hands on materials used
to craft the following sets
of armor: Khezu RX, Diablos
LX and Cephalos RX. I hope
your hunting career will be
long and fruitful.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monsters,
or deliver the items

title: ≪Special Material Quest≫ Nature's Chorus: A.Ridge
description:

Complete this Quest to get

I hope your hunting career

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Small Fry
description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。モンスター
を狩るだけがハンターじゃな
い。釣りだって立派な狩猟だ。
君も釣師を目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人でカジ
キマグロ１０匹の納品からだ。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Rookie
description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。次は日々の
研鑽の積み重ねを証明して貰
おう。一人でガノトトスの一
本釣りと魚拓【小】１０枚の
納品だ。ガノトトスは絶対に
狩らずに釣り上げるんだぞ。
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Reel Pro
description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。報酬は、
釣師の証になる、ある素材だ。
今までの集大成を見せてくれ！
釣りが目的だから、ガノトト
ス亜種は今回も絶対に狩らな
いように！
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Green Plesioth is hunted

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Legend
description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。
その腕前はもはや名人の域に
達しているじゃろ。
そこで、ワシから一子相伝の
技を授けてやろうかの。
条件は、魚拓【大】の納品と
ガノトトス変種の一本釣り
じゃ。待ってるぞ！
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Harvest Mining - Part 1
description:
You've come a long way,
haven't you? Hunting is
great, but mining is fun
too! How about you give
it a shot? I want you to
collect a lot of specific
ores. You'll get yourself
a special reward if you do.

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Harvest Mining - Part 2
description:
Mining is great. It helps
me relax. I always bring a
pickaxe when I go hunting!
For my next request, I want
you to deliver more quality
ore. Expect to be rewarded!

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Harvest Gathering - Part 1
description:
Good day, nice to meet you.
Have you been gathering out
on a hunt? I think it's high
time you showed us how far
you've come. Naturally, you
will be handsomely rewarded.

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Harvest Gathering - Part 2
description:
Back at it gathering today?
Instead of worrying about
tools, you want to focus on
getting new armor, right?
Well, I've got another favor
to ask. It might be a bit
harder than last time, but
please do your best. It'll
be worth it.

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Harvest Mining - Finale
description:
Time for my final request.
"Are you going to ask me to
go mining again?" -- No, all
I want you to do is exchange
the coins you've obtained so
far. By the way, I've never
had Khezu Ice Cream... Think
you could help with that?

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Harvest Gathering - Finale
description:
Time for my final request.
Although...giving you the
final coin just like that
would be anticlimactic...
I want you to fetch me a
Carnivore Egg. They're too
heavy for me to carry them
myself.

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Bearer of Good Fortune (Blade)
description:
Hey, it's you! Thanks for
getting me that salt the
other day! ...Just kidding.
It's YOU! You're the Master
Gatherer! It must be fate
for us to meet again like
this. Bring me the coins
again, and I'll give you
a new set!

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Bearer of Good Fortune (Gun)
description:
Hey, it's you! Thanks for
getting me that salt the
other day! ...Just kidding.
It's YOU! You're the Master
Gatherer! It must be fate
for us to meet again like
this. Bring me the coins
again, and I'll give you
a new set!

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Avatar of Prosperity: Blade
description:
It began as a small seed,
but through devoted care,
it grew into a bountiful
harvest -- and in time, it
brought true abundance.
Yet this is far from over.
Hear me, Mystic Tome owners!
For even greater prosperity
awaits you!

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Avatar of Prosperity: Gunner
description:
It began as a small seed,
but through devoted care,
it grew into a bountiful
harvest -- and in time, it
brought true abundance.
Yet this is far from over.
Hear me, Mystic Tome owners!
For even greater prosperity
awaits you!

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ And Thus, The Harvest Begins
description:
You've completed the two
master's requests! Your
reward will be a set of
coins used to craft a
certain piece of armor.
Oh yeah, I'm all out of
rock salt, could you go
get me some while you're
at it?

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Shell King: Seaside
description:
ひとつ、狩りをお願いする。
俺は大好きなんだ。
狩りは狩りでも潮干狩り！
将来は貝に埋もれて過ごすの
が夢なんだ。貝をいっぱいあ
つめてきてくれないか？
もちろん、報酬も弾むぜ？

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Shell King: Seafolk
description:
だいぶ集まってきた貝？
……なんてね。
貝の中に稀に入っている石。
これも必要なんだ。
大変だと思うが、もう少し
潮干狩りをお願いするよ。
報酬？
大丈夫。覚えているよ。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Shell King: Finale
description:
だいぶ集まってきたようだ。
俺の夢までもう一歩。
もう少し。
あともう少しだけ付き合って
欲しい。
もちろん、達成できた暁には
素晴らしいお宝をあげるよ。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Way of the Bugcatcher I
description:
この世界には様々な虫たちが
いるよね。
その中でも、私は≪キラビー
トル≫が好きでたくさん集め
てるの。
あなたも手伝ってくれるなら、
５０匹ごとに私のところに
持ってきて。
そしたら≪斬硬玉≫を１つあ
げるよ。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Way of the Bugcatcher II
description:
虫取り名人への道って何だろ。
間違っても道を歩くことじゃ
ないと思うの。
そんなことより、まだまだ
≪キラビートル≫を集めてい
るから持ってきてほしい。
何に使うかは秘密よ。
５０匹ほど納品したら、
≪極焔珠≫を３つあげるわ。

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 沈黙の大剣・冠婚の章
description:
「冠婚つらら」をご存じか？
男女が結ばれて子供が生まれ、
世代が一巡するほどの長い
時間をかけてできあがった、
ロマンあふれるつららなんだ。
知る者の少ない貴重品だが、
俺の依頼をこなしてくれたら、
少しくらいは分けてやれるぞ。

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 沈黙の大剣・千年の章
description:
見なれた密林であっても、
俺のようなプロにかかれば、
希少素材を見つけ出すことが
可能なのさ。あの辺に徘徊
する邪魔なモンスターさえ
片付けてくれれば、希少素材
「千年雪」を見つけてやるぜ。

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 沈黙の大剣・永久の章
description:
塔は実に謎の多い場所だな。
だが、極寒の地で育った俺の
直感が、ここに眠る希少素材
の存在を告げているんだ……。
ハンターさんにはいつも通り
邪魔なモンスターの狩猟を
お願いしたい。俺はその間に
素材探しをさせてもらおう！

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 沈黙の大剣・成就の章
description:
知っての通り、俺は探検家だ。
どんな苦労も恐れはしない。
そしてハンターさんよ、同じ
匂いをあんたからも感じるぜ。
高難度の仕事が、大願成就の
ための氷山の一角でしかない
とわかっていても、それでも
情熱を失わずに歩み続ける！
お互いやっかいな性分だな！
successCondition:
Hunt one of the target
monsters

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 破天の銃槍・盤石の章
description:
どんなものにも、本当の姿と
偽りの姿があります。まずは、
私からの依頼をこなすことで、
本物を見抜く目を鍛えなさい。
上手くいったら、私が集めた
奇妙な石を差し上げましょう。
特殊構造のガンランスを生産
することができるはずですよ。

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 破天の銃槍・道草の章
description:
目標に向かって進むことは
大切ですが、時には脇道に
それることも必要なのです。
「ネコかぶり」は道草を食う
ことでしか手に入れることが
できない特殊な植物です。
あなたのペースでじっくりと
集めるのがよいでしょう。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A.

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 破天の銃槍・豹変の章
description:
嘘をつくことは悪でしょうか。
時には、善意の嘘が人を救う
場合もあります。必要以上に
偽りを恐れてはなりません。
モンスターの狩猟を通して、
あなた自身が変わっていく
ことを願っております。

title: ≪長期イベントクエスト≫ 破天の銃槍・止揚の章
description:
白い紙に白い文字を書いても
読むことができませんよね。
黒い紙に黒い文字を書いても
同じことです。白と黒とが
組み合わさることで、初めて
新たな価値が生まれるのです。
相反するもの、その両方を
認めることで更なる価値を
生むこと、それが止揚です。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Explosive Ore: Part 1
description:
よぉ。久しぶりだな。
今日も楽しく採掘してるか？
また、採掘の良さを知っても
らう為に、依頼を用意したぞ。
さびた塊など５種類の中から
３つを集めてもらうぜ。
報酬はちゃんと用意してある
から安心して行ってこい！

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Explosive Ore: Part 2
description:
さて【後編】だ。
さびた塊などの５種類から、
【前編】とは違う２種類を納
品してもらうぞ。
報酬は、調合屋のあるじが
ある実験をしたい為に喉から
手が出るほど欲しがってる一
品だ。これで何をするのかは
知らんがな。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Explosive Ore: Finale
description:
採掘師が依頼した素材を見事
に集めきったようですね。
調合屋のあるじから聞いた話
によると、大量の琥珀の稀水、
翡翠の稀水に火薬岩を調合す
ると、爆発したように燃える
希少な鉱石ができるらしいの。
あなたも試してみない？

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Explosive Ore: Epilogue
description:
前の依頼で終わりなんだけど、
少し続きがあったみたい。
昔、超高温の石を発見した
のだけれど、この鉱石を運ぶ
ことができなかったの。
でも、あの水で冷却すると、
運べることが分かったわ。
だから、もう一度だけ大量に
納品してくれないかしら？

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Insect Prison
description:
モンスターの自由を奪う快感、
それは何物にも代えがたいわ。
私の≪濃縮クビキエキス≫を
使えば、あなたもその快感を
存分に味わうことができるの。
ただし、私が同類と認めた人
にしか渡さないのよ。小さな
束縛の繰り返しに楽しみを
見出せること。それが条件。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Insects of Fate
description:
モンスターの自由を奪う快感、
存分に味わっているかしら？
もしも、高みへ至った自信が
あるのなら、次のステップを
教えてあげてもいいのよ…。
爆発力を抑制する代わりに、
神をも縛ると言い伝えられる
≪テュライト純晶石≫…。
ちょっと試してみたくない？

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Mysterious Flowers 1
description:
わたしはねー花売りなのー。
でも、普段は広場にいません。
どこで売ってるか秘密なのー。
あ、そうだ。ハンターさんに
お願いがあるんだ―。
高地にあるイワヒメ草をたく
さん採ってきてほしいのー。
わたしにくれたら、遠くから
飛んできた種を１つあげるー。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Mysterious Flowers 2
description:
やっほー。花売りだよー。
ハンターさんからもらった
イワヒメ草を高地に植えたら
たくさんの花が咲いたよー。
やったね！
そういえば、高地で不思議な
水が湧く場所を見つけたんだ。
この水をわたしがあげた種と
交換してあげるよー。

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Mushroom Mania 1
description:
君もキノコマニアになりた
いって？
この道は君が考えているほど
簡単な道のりでは無いのだよ。
まずはコウザンダケを大量に
集めてくるんだ！
話はそれからだ！

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ Mushroom Mania 2
description:
よくここまで頑張ったね。
君のキノコ道はあと少しだ！
今まで集めた紫苑の稀袋を全
て私のところへ持ってくるん
だ！キノコマニアとしての証
を君に進呈しよう！

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ A Bouquet for your Love
description:
こんにちは。僕は愛と奇跡の
花束マイスターさ。ふむふむ、
ハートをズドンと射止めたい、
気になる相手がいるのかい？
それなら、僕に任せてよ！
指定の植物を集めてくれたら、
素敵な花束を作ってあげる。
君と出会えたこの運命を祝し、
心を込めて取り掛かるよ！

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Artisan
description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
ハンターはモンスターを狩る
だけじゃない。釣りだって立
派な狩猟だ。
釣師への道、しかも職人を
目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人で春夜
鯉５０匹の納品だ！

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Research
description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
次は日々の研鑽の積み重ねを
証明して貰おう。
その研究の証として、白銀の
秘壺１０個を納品してくれ！

title: ≪Long-Term Event Quest≫ The Angler's Path: Design
description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
貴重な壺を納品してくれれば、
お礼に、私が新しいリールの
設計図を作成して進呈しよう。
もちろん、普通のリールじゃ
ないがね。
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted

description:
Hear ye, hunters! Who among
you would slay the fearsome
Daimyo? It'll be you, the
monster, and the arena. No
holds barred! You're not in
it for the reward, right?
Think of the glory! Stand
tall with your comrades and
hone your hunting skills!

title: ≪Base Defense≫ Operation Magnetchaser
description:
An unidentified monster has
been spotted in the skies,
and is headed towards the
Square. Calling all hunters!
Use the weapons around the
base to intercept the target
and eliminate it. We've also
enlisted the aid of Master
Carvers for this operation.
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Danse Macabre
description:
大変です！現在、砂漠へ
向けて、何かが高速で
飛来しているとの情報です。
目撃者によると、見た目は
飛竜のようだったとの
話ですが…。情報不足
で申し訳ありませんが、
大至急、砂漠へ向かい
討伐してください！

title: ≪Base Defense≫ Operation Magnetbane
description:
≪ルコディオラ≫≪極龍≫と
名付けられたそれが、
≪迎撃拠点≫に迫っています。
十分な支給品、迎撃兵器、
そして剥ぎ取り職人と、万全
の態勢を整えさせていただき
ましたので、討伐をお願い
します！
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ A Shine in the Sandstorm
description:
現在、砂漠に飛来しつつある
モンスターが何であるか
判明しました。
光り輝く翼を持つ古龍種、
≪ルコディオラ≫です。
猛スピードで砂漠に
迫っています。
大至急、砂漠へ向かい
討伐してください！

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Heavenly Thunder
description:
Thanks to your efforts, new
paths have opened up in the
Canyon, sending traders over
the moon... Belkuros parts
are said to be all the rage
these days. This has sparked
the interest of the Guild,
causing them to *heavily*
encourage hunting it.

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Rolling with Thunder
description:
According to the merchants,
Belkuros parts are growing
more and more popular. The
Guild now provides a special
set of supplies, hoping to
further incentivize hunting
it. The rewards are, as per
usual, rare materials. What
exactly? You'll just have to
hunt and see!

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Frontal Thunderstorm
description:
If there's ever been a time
to hunt the Belkuros - it's
right NOW. Rumor has it that
the strongest individuals
have started popping up in
the Canyon. The Guild will
provide a special set of
supplies to aid you on the
hunt. Keep your wits about
you, hunters...

title: ≪Akantor Slaying≫ To Victory and Beyond
description:
An Akantor is wreaking havoc
on Guild territory! Through
our efforts, we've managed
to pinpoint its location to
be the Battlegrounds. Brave
hunters at the ready! It's
time to end this!

title: ≪Akantor Slaying≫ Warring Overlord
description:
We've received reports of
Aberrant Monsters showing
up in various locales.
They may look the same, but
their true abilities are
still shrouded in mystery.
Go out and investigate.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Dyegrass Hunters Assemble!
description:
≪センショク草≫という
不思議な草がある。
これは各地で採取が可能
で、特殊な装飾品を装着
できる武具の素材となる
のだ。わたしの依頼を
達成してくれたら、少し
君にも分けてあげよう。

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Hardcore Ticket Exchange
description:
ここは秘伝書を持つハンター
にのみ入場が許された交換所
だ。公式狩猟大会で優秀な成
績をおさめたことを証明する
証を納品すれば、賞品として
手に入れた武具を更に強化す
るための素材をやろう。生半
可な実力では手に入れること
はできんぞ？

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Egg Run Rewards: Power Gem
description:
いつもご苦労さん！
≪ハンターの本・白≫
≪ハンターの本・青≫
≪ハンターの本・赤≫
を全部持ってきてくれたら、
素敵な物と交換してやるよ。
これらを手に入れるには、
アプリで運搬をする必要が
あるみたいだな。
…アプリってなんだ？

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Felyne Force
description:
よう、こいつを見てくれよ。
いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ 鋭き鎌を閃かせ
description:
よう、お前もようやく凄腕
ハンターに到達したんだな。
ハンターズギルドから特殊な
武器を貰っただろ？あれは対
変種に適した武器で一部の
依頼を受ける条件にもなって
いる。
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
強化用の素材を分けてやるぜ。
やってみないか？

いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Yellow-hued Barrage
description:
よう、お前もようやく凄腕
ハンターに到達したんだな。
ハンターズギルドから特殊な
武器を貰っただろ？あれは対
変種に適した武器で一部の
依頼を受ける条件にもなって
いる。
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
強化用の素材を分けてやるぜ。
やってみないか？

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Operation Rustscraper
description:
An extremely powerful Rusted
Kushala Daora is headed for
Mezeporta! Calling all able-
bodied hunters to neutralize
the threat immediately!
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ The Thunderstruck Volcano
description:
We've received reports of
lightning strikes in the
volcanic belt. We'd like
to send the most esteemed
hunters to investigate.
Be advised, no supplies
will be provided for this
Quest. Exercise extreme
caution.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Hungering in the Highlands
description:
A Pariapuria has been
spotted in the Highlands!
It has no doubt devoured
numerous things, so its
probably got some fight
in it! Unfortunately, we
cannot provide you with
any supplies, please take
care while hunting!

title: ≪Mighty Quest≫ Fanged Invaders
description:
A pair of powerful Orgaron
have been spotted at the
Ancient Tower. At the moment
they seem to be staying in
one area, but if they move
out in search of prey, they
will cause extensive damage
to the surrounding area. We
cannot let that happen.

title: ≪Training: High Rank≫ Velocidrome Hunt (2P)
description:
We've got the perfect Quest
for any rookie hunter! We
have confirmed reports of
a relatively weak monster
in the area. Grab a partner
if you need to, head out,
and hunt the target!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Violent Sandstorm
description:
The Kushala Daora is far
removed from any monster
you've hunted this far.
It will likely throw your
own powerlessness into
stark relief. Don't even
try to capture it, focus
on steadily wearing it
down instead.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Raging Metal Mallet
description:
よう、こいつを見てくれよ。
いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

title: ≪Guild Order≫ The Legend Soaring the Skies
description:
The crew of our newly-built
vessel has spotted a strange
shadow in the clouds. It may
be one of the elder dragons
mentioned in ancient texts.
In light of your exploits,
we are formally requesting
your assistance. Head for
the skies and investigate.

title: ≪Guild Order≫ Polar Padrone
description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports of a
herd of Pokara in the Polar
Sea. We'd like to ask you to
help us study their ecology.

title: ≪Guild Order≫ Forest Fandango
description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports about
a strange bird wyvern in the
Great Forest. It's said to
emit a piercing shriek and
use thunderbolts to attack.
Please investigate.

title: ≪Guild Order≫ Storm of Spikes
description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
Our team of surveyors has
discovered a Hyujikiki in
the Highlands. Head out and
investigate ASAP.

title: ≪Guild Order≫ Volcanic Beast
description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
Our team of surveyors has
discovered a Midogaron at
the Volcano. The monster
is said to bear a striking
resemblance to an Orgaron,
but the details are unknown.
Please investigate ASAP.

title: ≪Guild Order≫ Ice-splitting Roar
description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
Witness reports speak about
powerful roars, similar to
that of an Abiorg, in the
Polar Sea. The details are
unclear, however. Proceed
with caution.

title: ≪Guild Order≫ Sea-Sawing Sovereign
description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports of
an Anorpatis in the Polar
Sea. The monster is known
to strike from underground
and assault its prey.
Proceed with caution.

title: ≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫ An Innocent Gaze
description:
I heard that you can see a
bunch of baby Pokara in the
Polar Sea... They're said to
dance in response to certain
movements. How cute! You can
go gather for a little, but
why not play with them? Just
don't be mean!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫ Northern Lights
description:
Polar nights are extremely
cold -- just standing still
can drain your Stamina. Make
sure you're well prepared.
By the way, they say that a
beautiful aurora stretches
across the night sky above
these frozen lands. If the
hunt proves too tiring, why
not enjoy the view?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫ Tidal Island Blessings
description:
We've received reports of
never-before-seen materials
at the Tidal Island. There
seem to be no monsters in
the area, making gathering
relatively safe. The Guild
is looking for hunters ready
to investigate the area.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫ Charmed by the Glow
description:
Insects are fascinating
creatures, don't you think?
Just looking at them fills
your heart with joy... The
Royal Rhino is particularly
beautiful. I could admire it
all day! But they're so hard
to find... Can you find one
for me?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫ The Blue Pack
description:
I was out researching the
Tidal Island, when suddenly
I got ambushed by a pack of
Velociprey! I've made a run
for it, but I've lost all my
spoils! I need you to hunt
them down and get back my
goods. If you've got time to
spare, could you mine some
ore for me?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫ Jungle Blessings
description:
I've recently ventured into
an uncharted region of the
Jungle, and found some very
interesting things. I've got
my hands on tons of items,
some of which have nobody
has ever seen before! The
monsters may be tough, but
the trip is well worth it!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫ Mushroom Masters
description:
Mosswine have an incredibly
keen nose for mushrooms --
they can sniff them out with
surprising accuracy. Maybe
there's a way to turn that
into a business? But first,
I need to learn more about
their behavior. Mind helping
me out with that?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫ Jungle Dust Devils
description:
We've received reports of a
group of Hermitaur emerging
from the sands and ravaging
a trade caravan. They then
retreated into an uncharted
part of the Jungle. We can't
allow them to cause any more
damage.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫ Seaside Screams
description:
We were staying on the Tidal
Island when suddenly a Yian
Kut-Ku showed up and ravaged
our food! Our getaway is all
but ruined... What's worse,
my lady is about to show up,
too. You've got to deal with
that vexing bird before she
arrives, please.

title: ≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫ Avian Tango
description:
A researcher surveying the
Jungle has spotted a Yian
Kut-Ku. According to him,
it seemed to differ from
usual individuals, but the
details are unknown. We're
looking for hunters ready
to head out and investigate
at once.

title: ≪GR1 Desert Survey≫ Desert Blessings
description:
The Desert is said to hold
many mysteries. Some claim
that there are whole regions
we haven't explored yet!
And these regions are said
to hold unimaginable riches.
We'd love to see it first-
hand, but desert nights are
harsh and unrelenting. We've
got no choice, but to ask
for help. Anyone up?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Desert Survey≫ Medicinal Wonders
description:
It was back when I'd gone to
gather ingredients for some
medicine. I'd found what I
was looking for and was just
about to leave, but then...
Cephalos! A boatload of 'em!
They robbed me! I'll pay you
a handsome sum, just get rid
of 'em! My poor herbs...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR1 Desert Survey≫ The Great Sunlit Shield
description:
A panicked adventurer claims
to have seen a Monoblos head
moving by itself. Obviously,
that's impossible, so it's
safe to assume that he saw
a Daimyo Hermitaur. Could
you look into it anyway?

title: ≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫ The Daimyo of the Caves
description:
There was this HUGE crab in
the caverns below the Tidal
Island. I've heard before
that it was covered in some
mighty tasty shrooms! But
the one I found had none...
Maybe it was a different
species? Could you check?

title: ≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫ Red-eyed Defender
description:
Having once stumbled upon a
Pokaradon, I couldn't help
but think: "Its hide would
make for a great product!"
Say, could I ask you to do
a little hunting for me?

title: ≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫ Leader of the Icy Herd
description:
I love researching monster
ecology and I'm willing to
go to great lengths for it.
That being said, if I die,
I won't be able to research
anything. Think you could
escort me?

title: ≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫ The Pink Plague
description:
I was out in an uncharted
part of the Marshlands when
suddenly... Congas! A whole
pack! I hightailed it outta
there, but that smell! What
a nightmare! If you happen
to be in the area, give them
a lesson for me, will ya?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫ Swampy Blessings
description:
We are looking for hunters
ready to study the ecosystem
of an unexplored region of
the Marshlands. We ask that
you slay the monsters native
to the area and deliver a
Goldenfish, if possible.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫ Ravager of the Swamp
description:
One of the few unexplored
parts of the swamp is being
ravaged by a Congalala. Not
only does it devour all the
mushrooms, but also leaves
that horrendous stench...
At this rate the ecosystem
will be all but ruined. We
need to deal with it ASAP.

title: ≪GR2 Jungle Survey≫ Stench Drenched Evening
description:
A horrible stench has been
wafting around my mistress's
manor. It would seem that a
Congalala has settled down
nearby. I cannot allow my
lady to be disturbed in her
quarters... Could you please
hunt that foul beast down?

title: ≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫ Marshlands Light Show!
description:
I was out and about in the
swamp, doing my job, when
suddenly I saw many bright
flashes of light in the
distance. The only monster
responsible I can think of
would be the Gypceros. I do
not want it interfering with
the investigation. Could you
lend me a hand?

title: ≪GR2 Jungle Survey≫ The Scourge of the Jungle
description:
According to our reports,
the Jungle is being ravaged
by a Gypceros flying at
night. If left unchecked,
the region will turn into
a desolate wasteland. This
needs to be dealt with ASAP.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Great Forest Blessings
description:
I'm so close to finishing
my ultimate dish... I just
need one more ingredient.
And don't think I'll settle
for anything but the best of
the best! I need an egg --
a PRIME Wyvern Egg! There's
a nest somewhere in the
Great Forest. You'll find
them there, I know it!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR2 Great Forest Survey≫ Shakalaka of the Forest
description:
We were on our way to look
into an unexplored area in
the Great Forest. It all
seemed fine until *they*
showed up again. I've saved
my skin, but what about my
comrades!? You've got to
save them, Hunter. Please!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR2 Great Forest Survey≫ Eccentric
description:
When I heard about that
flashy monster in the Great
Forest, I was shaken to my
core! That bold look, that
violent thunder! And don't
even get me started on that
one of a kind crest! I'd
love to make it part of my
hair. Think you can help
with that?

title: ≪GR2 Great Forest Survey≫ Forest-scorching Bolts
description:
The Falnocatrice is best
known for its remarkably
flashy appearance. Its
ecology remains largely
unknown, however. We are
looking for hunters to
aid us in our research.

title: ≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫ Volcanic Blessings
description:
I'm all outta Powderstones!
How am I supposed to hammer
away like this? Go grab some
for me, will ya'? It'd be
great if you could slay the
Bullfango in the area too.
As long as they're gone, I
can get the rest of 'em no
problem!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫ The Poisonous Pack
description:
I was out exploring the
Volcano when I stumbled
upon an honest to Gog 
treasure trove! I was
raring to go explore,
but the monsters there
proved quite formidable...
Please hunt them down.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫ The Rumbling Volcano
description:
During one of our Volcano
surveys, a researcher has
reportedly hit a sleeping
Basarios, causing it to
rampage. The investigation
cannot proceed as long as
the monster is not taken
care of. That's your job.

title: ≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫ Mischievous Rock
description:
We've received reports of
a rock suddenly attacking
travelers along a newly
built road. We've yet to
look into it, but it's safe
to assume that a Basarios
hit them. Head out and deal
with the threat before any
more damage is done.

title: ≪GR3 Verdant Hills Survey≫ Verdant Hills Blessings
description:
Through my research, I've
learned about an uncharted
part of the Verdant Hills
that's just teeming with
treasure. I'd love to head
there at once, but I need
someone to protect me while
I gather. If we make it out
alive, I'll reward you with
some of my findings!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Verdant Hills Survey≫ Creeping in the Dark
description:
I was out and about in the
Hills, when suddenly -- a
blue shadow pounced at me
out of nowhere! I made a run
for it and somehow made it
back, but... that's no way
to work! I'm at my wits' end
here, Hunter. Please, PLEASE
get rid of them!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Verdant Hills Survey≫ The Verdant Throne
description:
I hear that a Rathian has
made its nest deep within
an unsurveyed part of the
Verdant Hills. I'm sure
taking a quick peek will
lead me to SOME kind of
discovery...
Would you mind helping me?

title: ≪GR3 Great Forest Survey≫ Royal Forest
description:
We've received reports of
flying wyverns disrupting
the Great Forest. We need
you to deal with it ASAP.
The area has not yet been
fully surveyed, so please
take all the necessary
precautions.

title: ≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫ A Scythe Bathed in Crimson
description:
A trade convoy has been
attacked in an uncharted
region of the Volcano. Its
cargo has reportedly been
cut open by a sharp object.
What could have done this?
Please investigate at once.

title: ≪GR3 Marshlands Survey≫ Reaper of the Marsh
description:
I need help surveying the
Marshlands. Don't worry, no
gathering included. I hear
that the area I'm headed for
is frequented by Ceanataurs.
Going by myself would be
quite dangerous. Could you
help me out here?

title: ≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫ Highlands Blessings
description:
Have you heard? They've made
some new discoveries in the
Highlands. It turns out that
certain uncharted regions
are filled to the brim with
rare materials. I could take
you there if you'd like.
Just don't get in my way...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫ The Hunt for Luxury Fur
description:
I'm trying to make a coat
that'll keep me warm in the
bitter cold. I need someone
to gather the fur for me
though. And not just any old
fur. I need the best of the
best --  Bulluk fur from an
uncharted land -- or some-
thing like that. Could you
do me a favor?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫ Stormclad Highlander
description:
The Hyujikiki prides itself
on its agility and ferocity.
It is extremely territorial
and attacks everything that
dares intrude on its turf.
We can't do anything about
it without first studying
its ecology more thoroughly.
Please help us investigate.

title: ≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫ Storm-forged Thorns
description:
I was out exploring, when
suddenly I'd stumbled upon
a sharp needle. I've never
seen anything quite like it
before... Perhaps some kind
of monster left it behind?
Time is of the essence.
Head for the Highlands and
get to the bottom of this.

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Cold-Blooded Pack
description:
I was out gathering in the
Arctic Ridge, but a pack of
Giaprey attacked me and I've
lost everything! And now?
I'm going to die starving...
Sorry to ask this, but would
mind sharing some of your
Khezu Ice Cream...?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Arctic Ridge Blessings
description:
The Ridge may be harsh, but
its peaks are surely blessed
by Mother Nature herself.
I've heard tell that Popo
meat is most nourishing.
Would you be so kind as to
hunt some for me? Ah, and
perhaps gather a few Ice
Crystals as well. They are
great for alchemy, you know.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ King of the White Pack
description:
Having fully conquered the
uncharted regions of the
Arctic Ridge, the Blangonga
seems to be closing in on
inhabited areas. If left
unchecked, it could cause
major damage. Please deal
with it before that happens.

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Blangonga Know No Bounds
description:
Say, would you mind hunting
a Blangonga for some fur?
It might be really tough
and bristly, but it makes
for excellent clothing!
All you have to do is hunt
it, I'll do the carving off
myself. Counting on ya'!

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Thunderstruck in the Ridge!
description:
I was having the time of my
life, scaling the peaks of
the Arctic Ridge. There I
was, just about to reach the
summit when suddenly -- ZAP!
A bolt out of the blue! And
the skies were so clear...
I can't go on like this! Can
you look into it?

title: ≪GR4 Marshlands Survey≫ The Shadow in the Cave
description:
We've received reports of a
Khezu in an uncharted part
of the swamp. For everyone's
sake, please go and hunt it.
The Khezu is known for its
silent, but deadly attacks.
Try not to get caught by
surprise, alright?

title: ≪Guild Order≫ The Invoker of Calamity
description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports about
a mysterious elder dragon
heading towards Mezeporta.
We cannot let that happen.
Your job is to intercept and
neutralize the threat.

title: ≪GR4 Ancient Tower Survey≫ To Catch a Legend
description:
I found THE bug-catching
spot! Few would even think
of venturing there... but
someone like you shouldn't
have any trouble. You might
just catch a Hercudrome! Not
like you've got a choice...
A hot tip like that doesn't
come for free, you know!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR4 Ancient Tower Survey≫ The King's Tower
description:
A Rathalos seems to have
made that mysterious tower
its nest. I need to gather
there to make ends meet,
but with him around I'm
finished! Can you hunt it?

title: ≪GR4 Verdant Hills Survey≫ The King of all Skies
description:
As you may or may not know,
the Rathalos is often called
the "King of Skies." Well,
I'd like to become just as
strong as the king. I want
to use its fangs as a charm.
Could you hunt one for me?

title: ≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫ Volcano Buzzkill
description:
The Volcano is literally
swarming with Vespoids. One
of them wouldn't be a big
deal, but THIS? We need some
coal samples to conduct our
research, but as it stands,
we couldn't even hope to get
our hands on one of them.
Mind lending us a hand?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫ The Scythes Lurking Below
description:
We've received reports about
a large group of Ceanataur
in an uncharted part of the
Volcano. They are known to
burrow underground and lie
in wait, making them quite
difficult to find. For the
safety of our investigation,
we ask that you secure the
area.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫ Gone in a Flash
description:
I was out gathering off the
beaten path in the Volcano,
when suddenly an Orgaron
appeared right in front of
me! And then it was GONE!
Just like that! I have no
idea what happened... but,
if you choose to look into
this, PLEASE be careful.

title: ≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫ The Poisonous Pack
description:
I was out exploring the
Volcano when I stumbled
upon an honest to Gog 
treasure trove! I was
raring to go explore,
but the monsters there
proved quite formidable...
Please hunt them down.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫ Volcano Buzzkill
description:
There seems to be a Vespoid
outbreak in an unexplored
part of the Volcano. One of
them wouldn't be a big deal,
but a whole swarm? We need
a coal sample for research
purposes, but now we can't
go and grab it. Could you
help us out?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

successCondition:

Just don't get in my way...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,

title: ≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫ Unpleasant Buzzing
description:
I was out scaling the cliffs
in an uncharted part of the
Highlands, when suddenly I
was attacked by a swarm of
Vespoids! I've made it out,
but how could I ever come
back after something like
that? Please squash those
pesky bugs!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫ Stormclad Highlander
description:
The Hyujikiki prides itself
on its agility and ferocity.
It is extremely territorial
and attacks everything that

We can't do anything about
it without first studying
its ecology more thoroughly.
Please help us investigate.

description:

suddenly I'd stumbled upon

before... Perhaps some kind
of monster left it behind?
Time is of the essence.
Head for the Highlands and
get to the bottom of this.

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Arctic Ridge Blessings
description:
The Ridge may be harsh and
unrelenting, but its peaks
are surely blessed by Mother
Nature herself. Now, hunting
is all fine and dandy, but
but there's no call to be
hasty. Why not turn your
attention to gathering for
a spell, eh?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Cold-Blooded Pack
description:
I was out gathering in the
Arctic Ridge, but a pack of
Giaprey attacked me and I've
lost everything! I won't let
them get in my away again!
Think you could teach them
a lesson for me?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ King of the White Pack
description:
Having fully conquered the
uncharted regions of the
Arctic Ridge, the Blangonga
seems to be closing in on
inhabited areas. If left
unchecked, it could cause
major damage. You must not
let that happen.

title: ≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Blangonga Know No Bounds
description:
Say, would you mind hunting
a Blangonga for some fur?
It might be really tough
and bristly, but it makes
for excellent clothing!
All you have to do is hunt
it, I'll do the carving off
myself. Counting on ya'!

title: ≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫ Crimson Blitz
description:
We are looking for hunters
to help us investigate the
Midogaron. We believe its
solitary lifestyle to be a
byproduct of its immense
strength, which eliminates
the need to travel in a
pack. This is an extremely
dangerous request. Make all
the necessary preparations.

title: ≪GR5 Marshlands Survey≫ The Crystal's Red Guard
description:
Ohh, I've had it with those
Ioprey! They've chosen to
nest at my favorite Quartz
Ore mining spot! How am I
supposed to go there now!?
Please go and mine it for
me! Oh, and if you get rid
of those red fiends, I'll
make sure to reward you
handsomely.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR5 Marshlands Survey≫ Marshland Gluttons
description:
I was out in the swamp, but
then... disaster struck. The
Conga attacked me... again.
Not only did they fart on
me, but they also stole ALL
of my mushrooms! Please get
rid of them! Oh and if you'd
be so kind... Could you help
me gather some mushrooms?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR5 Marshlands Survey≫ Reshaping the Marshlands
description:
A Gravios has been spotted
in an uncharted part of the
Marshlands. It seems to be
on the hunt for minerals.
We can't allow it to go on.
Otherwise it might just dry
up the whole area with that
heat beam...

title: ≪GR5 Volcano Survey≫ Scorching Advance
description:
We've discovered a large
set of footprints in the
Volcano. While we can't
be sure, judging by their
size, they may belong to
a Gravios. Track it down
and investigate.

title: ≪GR5 Desert Survey≫ A Roar to the Heavens
description:
A Tigrex has been spotted
in an uncharted part of the
Desert. According to our
reports, the environment is
harsh, food is scarce, and
the monster is particularly
angry. It needs to be dealt
with before it closes in on
human settlements.

title: ≪GR5 Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Arctic Apex
description:
A Tigrex showed up out of
nowhere in the Arctic Ridge
and is massacring all the
herbivores! We're in dire
need of food, but at this
rate we're going to starve!
Can you help us?

title: ≪GR5 Canyon Survey≫ Lily of the Valley
description:
The Canyon is home to a
special variety of cacti.
Their sap is an extremely
valuable substance used in
various medicines. We are
looking for volunteers to
assist us in collecting
said sap.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR5 Canyon Survey≫ Canyon Blessings
description:
I'm all out of salt! I was
going to go gather some in
the Canyon, but there's a
swarm of Great Thunderbugs
in the way! Can you deal
with them? It'd be a huge
help if you could get me
some Rock Salt too...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR5 Canyon Survey≫ The Great Devourer
description:
We've spotted a Pariapuria
in an unsurveyed part of
the Canyon. The situation
is under control, but with
it being so close to a busy
road, disaster's bound to
strike sooner than later.
Are there any hunters up
for the task?

title: ≪GR5 Tidal Island Survey≫ A Whirlpool-like Appetite
description:
There's a Pariapuria at the
Tidal Island! It showed up
out of nowhere and started
devouring plants and beasts
one after another! At this
rate, the ecosystem will be
ruined! At this time of day,
it might be by the water...
You must hunt it! Hurry!

title: ≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫ Polar Sea Blessings
description:
There seems to be a rare
herb found only during the
day in the Polar Sea. The
Guild has tasked us with
gathering some, but despite
our best efforts, we weren't
able to find a single one...
Would you mind helping us
find some?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫ The Frozen White Pack
description:
I was out investigating the
Polar Sea, when suddenly I
had stumbled upon a pack of
Giaprey. I don't know where
they came from, but I think
it's worth investigating.
Hunt them down and help us
study their ecology.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫ The Vengeful Polar Blade
description:
Using its claws, fangs, or
the tail, the Giaorg can
cause large cracks to form
in the ice floor. If kept
unchecked, it could turn
the area into complete ruin,
preventing any further
investigations. It must be
dealt with ASAP.

title: ≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫ Breaking the Ice
description:
I couldn't help but notice
all the cracks in the ice
while surveying the Polar
Sea. I suppose it was the
work of a Giaorg. How about
a little hunt to break the
ice? Just don't get eaten!
It can be quite violent
when chasing down prey...

title: ≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫ Researcher Essentials
description:
ああ大変だ…。調査に行く時
必要になる火薬草を切らして
しまった…。
あれがないと火を起こすこと
ができず、凍えてしまう！
誰か火薬草と、できれば
起こした火を乗せられる
燃えない器になる物を
持ってきてくれないか！？
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫ Volcano Food Crisis
description:
My food supplies are getting
a bit low... Would you mind
hunting a few Aptonoth for
me? Their meat and eggs make
great food. Oh, how about a
Powderstone too? It's great
fuel, you know. Well anyway,
if you've got time, I would
really appreciate it.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫ Shadow of the Burning Sea
description:
A hunter headed for the
Volcano reports to have
seen something swimming
in the lava. It may very
well be a Lavasioth, but
we haven't spotted any of
them in that area. Could
you please head out and
investigate?

title: ≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫ Lord of the Lava Sea
description:
未調査地域にある火山に、
ヴォルガノスが生息している
ことが分かりました。
ヴォルガノスは溶岩の中を
好き勝手に泳ぎ回るため、
放っておけば噴火してしまう
危険があります。
急ぎヴォルガノスの狩猟に
向かって頂けませんか？

title: ≪GR6 Great Forest Survey≫ Venom in the Verdure
description:
I was walking through the
bushes when suddenly -- a
sleeping Espinas! I was
shocked, to say the least.
I almost bumped into it and
got one of its thorns into
my arm... I've never seen
one in a place like that!

title: ≪GR6 Ancient Tower Survey≫ Thorn-ridden Tower
description:
We've received reports about
an Espinas in an uncharted
part of the Ancient Tower.
We've tried our best to
investigate without waking
it from its slumber, but at
some point it attacked us
anyway. We need you to help
us make it out in one piece!

title: ≪Grand Tournament≫ Slay the opponent's monster!
description:
相手チームのモンスターを
討伐すれば勝利することが
できます！この大闘技会の
大闘技場には、一発逆転が
狙える様々なアイテムが、
地面に眠っています。相手
モンスターを狙うも、アイ
テムを狙うも自由です！
failCondition:
Your monster is defeated,
or time expires

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Specialties
description:
Psst... I've found a hidden
gem BRIMMING with treasure.
You've got to check it out.
If you come back with your
Pouch full, it'll be worth
every Zenny spent. You've
got my word.

description:
Psst... I've found a hidden
gem BRIMMING with treasure.

every Zenny spent. You've

description:
