title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Such is the Great Forest
description:
樹海はまだまだ未開の地です。
いきなり狩りに出かけないで、
まずは探索でもどうでしょう？
この地にあると言われている、
あるモンスターのねぐらから
≪かけた貝殻≫を１つだけ
見つけて納品してください。
余裕があればサブもどうぞ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Mushrooms, Again
description:
お待ちかね。狩場の情報です。
今回の狩場は、鬱蒼と茂る
木々と、どこか神秘的な
空気を感じる樹海です。
生態の調査も兼ねて、
特産キノコ１２個の納品を
お願いします。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Forest Hypnotist
description:
The Great Forest... a land
beyond which no civilization
has ever encroached. We know
not what strange, wonderful
forms of life await us, but
our research can only begin
after securing a foothold in
the locale...

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Slumbering Bird
description:
やられた…。
砂漠の眠鳥に隊商の車ごと
持って行かれちまった…。
奴は狡猾で、俺たちを眠らせて
から、まんまと積荷だけを
せしめて行くんだ。
ハンターさんよ、奴をどうにか
してくれ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Royal Warfare
description:
樹海付近を通って、他地方に
抜ける旅人から、飛竜による
被害報告が多数出ておる。
樹海をねぐらとしている飛竜
の数を減らせば、この被害も
ある程度収束するじゃろう。
おぬしらの働きに期待してお
るぞ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Great Forest Egg Hunt
description:
傷つき、病に苦しむ患者には
滋味ある食物が必要だ。
しかし、そういった食物は
一部富豪の口にしか入らない
のが、現実なのだ。
せめて、広場の患者だけでも
手厚い医療を施したい。
ハンター諸君、頼んだぞ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Lava Lurker
description:
火山に広がる溶岩の海には
溶岩竜≪ヴォルガノス≫が棲
んでいます。吐き出す溶岩と
巨体を活かした攻撃は一瞬の
油断が死につながります！
特にその巨体を使った突進は
要注意です！
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Omens of Disaster
description:
何やら塔に多くのガブラスが
群れ集っておるようじゃ。
奴らは災厄の前触れとも言われ
ておるゆえ、ギルドとしても
捨ててはおけぬ。
ガブラス８頭を討伐し、状況
を確認してきて欲しい。

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ The Rathalos's Lair
description:
The Rathalos is said to nest
somewhere atop the Ancient
Tower. We are looking for
hunters ready to infiltrate
its nest and confirm the
rumors. Heads up! You are
going up against THE King of
the Skies after all...

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ The Azure Rathalos's Lair
description:
The Azure Rathalos is said
to nest somewhere atop the
Ancient Tower. We are
looking for hunters ready
to confirm the rumors once
and for all. Your target is
extremely dangerous. Do not
let your guard down.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Arboreal Slumber
description:
With their plethora of uses,
the demand for Hypnocatrice
parts is as unrelenting as
always... We ask that you
head to the Great Forest
and hunt the target.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Slumber
description:
A fellow wanderer nearly met
his demise in the Desert!
He said that he had suddenly
felt drowsy, had fallen
asleep, and had suffered
from heatstroke. It's got
to be the work of that bird!
Please get rid of it! And do
stay safe!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Rookie Hunter Support
description:
Calling all rookie hunters!
A pesky Bulldrome has been
wreaking havoc to the fields
around Mezeporta. We ask
that you take care of it.
You will be handsomely
rewarded!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Machalite Mania!
description:
When it comes to equipment,
Machalite's bound to show
up at some point... Don't
you just hate going mining
and going back empty-handed?
Well fear not! Hunt a pair
of Velocidrome and you will
be rewarded with at least
two Machalite Ores!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Into the Fire
description:
Have you heard of the newly
discovered piscine wyvern?
Its name is Lavasioth, and
I'm off to see it! Or so I
thought... Truth be told I
completely chickened out...
Mind going out and having a
look for me?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Ruler of the Volcano
description:
We've been hired to gather
some ore to fortify Dundorma
against elder dragons, but
we're really feeling the
heat over here! Help us out
will you? Either hunt the
Lavasioth or deliver a few
Powderstones! Counting on
you, brave hunters!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Tigrex's Roar
description:
I ran into a beast I had
never laid eyes on before.
Its claws were so strong,
they could probably tear
apart just about anything...
Even them toughest armor
was like a piece of cloth
to them... This one's bound
to put up a real fight!

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Resounding Roar
description:
I saw a Tigrex out in the
Ridge! To think that a beast
like that could live in such
a cold region... Looks like
it'll hunt anywhere as long
as there's prey to be taken.

description:

Quest will reward you with
a hefty sum of Hunter Rank
points. If you're looking

take on stronger threats,
this Quest is for you!

The Kushala Daora is a
different monster from
anything you've hunted this
far. Its very presence can
transform rain into a storm.
Capturing it is a waste of
time, so concentrate on
steadily hammering away
at it instead.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Ravaging Rainstorm
description:
The Kushala Daora is a
different monster from
anything you've hunted this
far. Its very presence can
transform rain into a storm.
Capturing it is a waste of
time, so concentrate on
steadily hammering away
at it instead.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Jungle Phantom
description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the elder dragons.
It's almost as if the Jungle
rain is on his side, as it
grows more intense when he's
nearby. Trying to capture
him is a waste of time, so
concentrate on steadily
hammering away instead.

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Lightning Strikes the Tower
description:
The mythical beast Kirin
has been sighted at a Tower,
located in a mysterious
unexplored region beyond
the reaches of this land.
It can only be accessed when
the climate is just right.
Good luck!

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Lightning Strikes the Tower
description:

unexplored region beyond

Good luck!

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Slay the Velociprey!
description:
Velociprey are small
carnivorous bird wyverns
with scaly blue skin.
They're quick on their feet,
so landing an attack can
be difficult. However,
blinding them with a Flash
Bomb should stop them in
their tracks.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Slay the Hermitaur!
description:
Hermitaurs are small
Carapaceons with incredibly
hard shells. Be careful if
you spy smoke rising from
the ground -- they are known
to lurk underground and
attack any who draw near.
Lob a Sonic Bomb at them,
and victory is yours!

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Slay the Conga!
description:
Conga are small fanged
beasts with pink fur. If
they turn their backs on
you, it's a sign that
they're set to expel a
pungent gas of dubious
origins. It can render
you incapable of using
items, so watch out.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Slay the Bullfango!
description:
Bullfango are small fanged
beasts with large tusks.
They are pesky foes who
live only to charge head-on
at their target. Draw their
attack, dodge, and then hit
them from behind!

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Slay the Genprey!
description:
Genprey are small meat-
eating bird wyverns that
inhabit the Desert and
resemble Velociprey. Take
a hit from one, and you're
liable to be stunned and
rendered temporarily
defenseless.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Slay the Ioprey!
description:
Ioprey are small meat-
eating bird wyverns that
resemble Velociprey.
They are known to spit
venom that will gradually
drain your Health on
contact. Should you
become poisoned, use an
Antidote without delay.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ What's a Velocidrome!?
description:
The Velocidrome is the
leader of the Velociprey
pack, with a larger body
and more prominent crest.
Just think of it as a larger
and tougher version of a
Velociprey and slash away!

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Hunt the Velocidrome!
description:
Now, onto the hunt proper.
Hunt down a Velocidrome in
the Jungle. Be aware that
in the wild, this beast is
liable to run away to a
nearby area to recover
health when injured.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ What's a Bulldrome!?
description:
The Bulldrome is the
leader of the Bullfango
family, and is notable for
its larger body and tusks.
As you can probably imagine,
it’s a somewhat reckless
foe, so use the same tactics
you employ when battling a
Bullfango.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Hunt the Bulldrome!
description:
Now then, on to the real
hunt! Hunt down a Bulldrome
in the Jungle. Bulldromes
you encounter in the wild
are liable to run away to
a nearby area to recover
health when injured.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ What's a Gendrome!?
description:
The Gendrome is the extra-
large leader of the Genprey
pack. More aggressive than
a Velocidrome, it will hit
back if you get too greedy
with your attacks. Watch out
for its stun attack, too.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Hunt the Gendrome!
description:
Now, on to the real hunt!
Hunt down a Gendrome in the
Desert! It's cold out there
at night, so be sure to take
a Hot Drink to stay warm, or
your max Stamina will
gradually decrease.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ What's an Iodrome!?
description:
The Iodrome is the leader
of the Ioprey pack, with
a distinctive larger body
and purple crest. Utilize
all you have learned up to
now, and you should be able
to overcome this beast, but
beware of its vicious and
venomous spit!

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Hunt the Iodrome!
description:
Now then, on to the real
hunt! Track down an Iodrome
in the Marshlands. At night,
poisonous spots appear on
the ground, so today's hunt
will take place during
daylight hours. Good luck
out there!

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ What's a Yian Kut-Ku?
description:
The Yian Kut-Ku is a bird-
like wyvern notable for its
large ears and beak.
Sensitive to loud sounds, it
can be stunned, but be sure
to exercise caution -- after
being stunned, it will grow
enraged, and become even
more powerful than usual.

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Hunt the Yian Kut-Ku!
description:
Now then, on to the real
hunt! Track down a Yian
Kut-Ku in the Jungle.
Knowing your enemy, and
countering its attacks
accordingly, is the key
to a successful hunt. Take
the tail for example -- it
only spins counterclockwise!

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ Deliver a Carnivore Egg!
description:
You'll often find eggs,
including Carnivore Eggs,
in corners where scattered
bones lie, or on slightly
elevated sections. If you
do manage to get hold of a
Carnivore Egg, deliver it
by bringing it back to the
Red Box in the Camp.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ The Absolute Basics
description:
It's your trusty instructor
once again. The Quest Info
column is jam-packed with
important info such as the
contract fee needed to take
on a Quest, the reward
received when a Quest is
cleared, the Quest goals,
and the time limit.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ BBQ Basics
description:
It's your trusty instructor
once again. The Quest Info
column is jam-packed with
important info such as the
contract fee needed to take
on a Quest, the reward
received when a Quest is
cleared, the Quest goals,
and the time limit.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Hunter Gathering
description:
Here's another lesson from
your favorite instructor.
Kudos for checking here.
No matter what the Quest,
be sure to check here.
On this Quest, you'll be
hunting for Honey. Find a
beehive, and it's as good
as yours!

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Combining Basics
description:
All set for today's lesson?
Now, every object has a set
combo success rate, so if at
first you don't succeed,
try, try again! You'll find
Combo recipes in the Combo
List in the Start Menu.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Fishing Fundamentals
description:
You guessed it--it's your
one and only instructor!
Now, the fish inhabiting
fishing points differ in
each location, so remember
where to net the fish you
need. The type of fish also
changes with the season. Ah,
the wonder of mother nature!

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Sword School
description:
Now listen up, 'cos this is
important! You need to bag
5 Velociprey to clear this
Quest. Once you get the hang
of handling your weapon,
it's time to hone your
hunting skills. Keep your
eyes peeled for blue scales!

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Stolen Egg Scramble
description:
Now let me, AHEM, eggsplain
something to you. Take a hit
when carrying an egg and the
yolk will be on you. Pay
attention to what's going on
around you by panning the
camera using {K073}{K080}{K068}{K069}.
Oh, and if your stamina runs
out, say g'bye to that egg.

title: ≪Hunter Basics≫ Basic Hunting
description:
The battle with the 
Velocidrome begins! Make
good use of the items
supplied, and give it your
all! Once you're adept at
slaying your prey, study the
art of monster capture in
order to diversify your
hunting options.

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Golden Groan
description:
How about trying a new kind
of Subquest? Don't worry --
we'll keep track of the
damage you deal, so you can
focus on the Main Objective.
What do you say? Are you up
to the task?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Arctic Delivery
description:
Delivering items is a vital
part of a hunter's job, and
here at the Guild, we do all
we can to support hunters as
they discharge their duties.
The Arctic Ridge, with its
drops and dips, is an ideal
place to show off your
transportation skills.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Marine Moresco
description:
A Plesioth with a Daimyo
Hermitaur... A curious
combination, but they've
been discovered together
in the Jungle. Top-class
hunters will no doubt
welcome the chance to get
their hands on these two
marine monsters. Happy
hunting!

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Paw in Claw
description:
We've received a report that
an unusual monster pairing
has been seen in the swamp.
To think that a Congalala
would team up with a Shogun
Ceanataur... This looks like
it would be well worth
further investigation.

title: ≪Extra Quest≫ A Tour of the Jungle (LR)
description:
It's what you've all been
waiting for! Yes, it's time
for an Extra Quest, courtesy
of the Public Tavern. We've
provided a lovely, quiet
area for you to gather items
to your heart's content.
Enjoy!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Egg Dream!
description:
Spring has come! Head to
the Jungle at night and
snatch those eggs! You
may be rewarded with Gold
or Silver Eggs. Selling
those will net you a tidy
sum! If you're looking to
strike it rich, do not
waste this opportunity!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Felyne Showdown!
description:
As if Felynes and Melynxes
weren't enough, a couple of
Velocidrome have even found
their way into the Arena!
Your job is to take out 2
Felynes, but there's a fin
reward waiting for you if
you deal with 40 Melynxes
too!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Vespoid Outbreak
description:
Listen to my tale! I found a
vast forest in an unexplored
region. No sooner did I set
foot in it than I faced a
huge swarm of Vespoids. I 
escaped with my life, but I
left my precious belongings.
Won't someone chase that
hideous herd away for me?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Hornetaur Outbreak
description:
No sooner had that wretched
swarm disappeared than I was
up to my eyes in a horrible
horde of Hornetaurs. My
precious belongings are
still there. Won't someone
get rid of those beasts?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Yian Garuga Attacks!
description:
A noble hunter such as I
must tread a solitary path.
And yet I will share some
useful information with the
amateur hunters who make
Dundorma their base. The
Garuga, a lone wolf like
me, is nearby. This fierce
beast awaits challengers...

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ A Rouge King
description:
So I licked my wounds from
my last misadventure, and
got back on the proverbial
horse. All was going well
until th-that thing with its
head ablaze... Now, listen!
I beseech you! Join forces
with me and let us finish
this job.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Royal Warfare - Reprise
description:
We had believed that the
wyvern incident was dealt
with, but more reports are
coming in of folks in the
Great Forest coming under
attack. We ask that you
head back there and deal
with this airborne threat.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Ore Hunters Assemble!
description:
Iron Ore is essential for
improving your equipment.
Ensure you don't run low
at the wrong moment by
achieving the Main Target
in this Quest and earning
no less than 7 hunks of
precious Iron Ore!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Jungle Relaxation
description:
Bring me supplies for the
medicine I'm researching,
and I'll make it worth your
while. I'll give you any
leftover potion materials
so you can try out some
combining for yourself.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Extra Order: Forest Eggs
description:
My poor, suffering patients
need nutritious food. At the
very least, I wish I could
do something for my patients
here in the Square, but
supplies are thin on the
ground. Perhaps you could
help me out?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ Verdant Hills Specialties
description:
The distant Verdant Hills
are bursting with all manner
of natural bounty. Ambitious
hunters aiming for a Rank of
51 should be well able to
make the most of the items
on offer. I highly recommend
that you take a trip there.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Grocery Bonanza
description:
The mating season's in full
swing, monsters are out and
about, and that means lots
of business from hunters.
Trouble is, it's hard to
keep up with demand. Could
you get some supplies for
me? There's a reward in it!

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Grocery Crisis
description:
Ah, winter's here and it
makes getting supplies in
a real pain in the neck.
I don't suppose you could
lend a hand, could you?
I've got an exclusive,
hand-picked ingredient
to give you as a reward.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Grocery Order
description:
Ah, the hot weather brings
customers in their droves!
They want healthy fare to
stop the heat draining them.
Business is good, but I'd
sure appreciate some help
getting supplies. You'll
be rewarded with my own
exclusive ingredient!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Raging Gunpowder
description:
I want it! I need it! I MUST
have it! What do I want, you
ask? Why, adorable Kut-Ku
furniture, of course! Hunt
them down for me and I'll
give you gunpowder materials
I stole from the storeroom!
Don't miss out!

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Piece of Cake
description:
There aren't too many takers
for odd jobs, so the Guild
has combined a few tasks,
and prepared a suitable
reward. It's an easy mission
to do while you're out
mining, but remember your
Pickaxe or you'll definitely
have to retire defeated.

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Easy Pickings
description:
Hunters are often not keen
on small tasks, but the
little jobs are important,
too. This is a great Quest
for hunters who have just
risen up the ranks, and want
to stock up on supplies. But
you won't get far without
packing your Pickaxe!

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Bow Bonus
description:
A dazzling reward awaits all
aficionados of the fine art
of bowmanship. High-ranking
hunters can now get their
hands on a fine collection
of Gunner Equipment. It's
a nice, easy Quest, so why
not form a party and take
it on?

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Source of Life
description:
We're offering you a great
chance to stock up on meat.
Take a trip to the home
of the Aptonoth, and you'll
find there's meat in
plentiful supply.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Gladiatorial Garuga
description:
To the hunters of Dundorma,
I bring you news of a beast
after my own heart, a lone
wolf, the Yian Garuga.
I sense that it is ready for
a fight to the death, so any
who hunt it must be prepared
to kill or be killed.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Vespoid Outbreak!
description:

vast forest in an unexplored
region. No sooner did I set

huge swarm of Vespoids. I 
escaped with my life, but I

Won't someone chase that
hideous herd away for me?

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Harbingers of Horror
description:
The Tower appears to have
been overrun by Remobra.
These beasts are known as
harbingers of calamity, so
the Guild cannot sit idly
by. Investigate the
situation, and slay 8
Remobra while you're at it!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Black Horns
description:
A Diablos has been sighted,
its black body striking any
who see it dumb with horror.
There is believed to be only
one, so any capable hunter
should be able to deal with
it. But if you take victory
for granted, you may be in
for a rude awakening.

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ Delivery Work
description:
Think huntin's just about
baggin' big bad monsters?
You got it dead wrong!
Bein' a hunter also means
you gotta do your share
of heavy liftin'. And that's
good, honest work. So, you
ready to work up a sweat
or what?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The Red Wing's Trail
description:
How about trying a new kind
of Subquest? Don't worry --
we'll keep track of the
damage you deal, so you can
focus on the Main Objective.
What do you say? Are you up
to the task?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Fistful of Fish
description:
Up ahead, where I'm going
to hawk my wares, they've
got no taste. They rate
moldy old mushrooms higher
than fish! Can you believe
it!? If you can supply me
with fungus, I'll reward
you with the finest fish
you've ever smelled!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ The Budding Great Forest
description:
As hunters rise up the
ranks, they tend to head
out on hunt after hunt
without taking time to rest.
We hope that heading out
to the Great Forest this
time will be a welcome
break from the norm.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Trap Tutor
description:
Good traps don't attract
attention. Oh no. A trap
worthy of the name waits
quietly in the shadows.
First, gather the right
components. The Great Forest
is a fine place to build a
trap with locally-sourced
items, so go get 'em!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Shot in the Arm
description:
This request just in from a
Guild associate. It's just
some minor tasks, but the
reward is a healing tonic
that can help you out of a
tight spot, anytime. This
Energy Drink has the Guild's
gold-plated seal of approval.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Honest Gathering
description:
The first step to hunting
success is a good approach
to gathering items. The
Guild has prepared this
Quest to ensure you don't
forget this important first
principle. Work hard, and
you'll blossom just like the
reward -- an Adamant Seed.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ The Azure Hypnotist
description:
I hear that during Spring,
Hypnocatrice bodies turn a
vivid azure. Now's the time
to try to catch a glimpse.
But you'd better hurry
before someone beats you
to it!

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Azure Hypnocatrice
description:
If I could only get hold of
a rare and gloriously Blue
Hypno Pelt, I'd make myself
a dress and be undisputed
belle of the ball. Could
you get me one?

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Red Magma Wyvern
description:
This afternoon I decided to
pay a sly visit to the lair
of the Lavasioth. I nearly
dropped my weapons in shock
when I saw a Lavasioth of a
shade I'd never seen before.
I got roughed up bad before
I escaped. I'd reward anyone
who hunted that thing down.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Tigrex's Roar
description:
The Tigrex is a beast that
boasts overwhelming power,
but no monster in this world
is without its weak point.
I've analyzed this, and I
believe its head to be
vulnerable. Aim to strike
it as it turns around.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Dominant Power
description:
I may have underestimated
my opponent. Even if you're
used to facing its kind,
no two monsters are the
same, and this is a tough
customer, believe me. Do
not drop your guard till
you've finished the job.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Gathering: Jungle (Summer)
description:
The Dyegrass is a rare plant
that only seasoned experts,
well-versed in nature, can
tell apart from its many
imitations. For this reason,
we have prepared a special
Quest tailored to HR100
hunters.

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Crafting: Lrg Armor Spheres
description:
Tis' a fine thing to have a
new way to improve armor,
but it's going to require
Armor Spheres. When it comes
to making them, I'm your
man. There are a few types,
but let's focus on the Large
Armor Spheres for now. Bring
me those fragments!

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ The Den of Dread
description:
I needed to know what sort
of creature lurked in the
virgin terrain of the Great
Forest, but what I found
there... Just thinking of
it sends a chill down my
spine. I left some of my
friends there. Please, you
must help me!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Lone Horn
description:
The solitary one-horned
wyvern Monoblos is one of
the twin rulers of the
Desert alongside the
Diablos. To hunt one alone
is the mark of a top-class
hunter. Are you up to the
challenge?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The White Horn's Wrath
description:
A white wyvern thought to be
an extremely rare Monoblos
subspecies has arrived on
the scene. Only a hunter
in a class of their own
could hope to hunt this
beast alone. Are you up to
the challenge?

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Fallen Sun
description:
The Lunastra is an elder
dragon said to be born
of flame -- an avatar of
the inferno. We can send
but a single Hunter on an
expedition to the frontier
lands where it resides.
Who can fly solo and slay
this beast?

we can send but one hunter.
It will be enough to repel
the beast, but slay it if
you can!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Warrior of Valor
description:
There was once a hunter so
brave and strong that their
name lives on in the annals
of the Guild. But even that
warrior was forced to give
up when facing the Plesioth.
We have a handsome reward
for any hunter who can fly
solo and slay this beast.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ The Forest Lord's Awakening
description:
In the depths of the forest
it lurked, waiting quietly,
biding its time until its
prey appeared... Its power
is beyond formidable, and
any who would hunt it must
beware of its poisonous
thorns.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Deities of Death
description:
Terrifying Black Diablos
have been sighted. Those
who have been engulfed in
their shadows know them as
the Deities of Death. Is
there a hunter who dares
to take up arms against
these Desert-stalking
demons?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Red and Black Armor
description:
Hey, d'you hear about that
Lavasioth subspecies they
discovered? Well, you're
lookin' at the guy who's
gonna take it out.
...What's that!? A black
subspecies has been seen,
too? Then I guess we can
split the honors between us.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Daimyo of the Jungle
description:
We've received reports of
Aberrant Monsters showing
up in various locales.
They may look the same, but
their true abilities are
still shrouded in mystery.
Go out and investigate.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A

Public Tavern for 8 Wyvern

a solo hunter to handle,
so we recommend having at
least one other Hunter on
board. Be aware that you
won't get any Supply Items
for clearing the Subquest.
successCondition:

or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Ravaging Rainstorm
description:
The Kushala Daora is a
different monster from
anything you've hunted this
far. Its very presence can
transform rain into a storm.
Capturing it is a waste of
time, so concentrate on
steadily hammering away
at it instead.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Jungle Phantom
description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the elder dragons.
It's almost as if the Jungle
rain is on his side, as it
grows more intense when he's
nearby. Trying to capture
him is a waste of time, so
concentrate on steadily
hammering away instead.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Sandy Stormbringer
description:
The Kushala Daora is far
removed from any monster
you've hunted this far.
It will likely throw your
own powerlessness into
stark relief. Don't even
try to capture it, focus
on steadily wearing it
down instead.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Scorched by the Sands
description:
The Teostra is an elder
dragon said to be an avatar
of the inferno. Its ferocity
puts it in a terrifying
class all its own. Don't
even think about trying to
capture it, just hammer
away and wear it down.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Silent Swamp
description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the Elder Dragons. It
is capable of vanishing in
a flash, making it feared
even by the most elite of
hunters. Trying to capture
it is no use. Concentrate
on steadily hammering away
instead.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Ruler of the Flame
description:
The Teostra is said to be an
avatar of the inferno. Its
fiery cloak will mercilessly
sap away at your Health at
close range... You have no
hope of capturing it. Focus
on steadily wearing it down
instead.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Phantom of the Snowfield
description:
The elder dragon Kirin is
so rare that it is known
as a Mythical Beast, and
has no fixed habitat. Oh,
and if you make it to the
summit, be sure to plant
the Guild Flag up there!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

description:

among the Elder Dragons. It
is so rare that, even now,

use. You'd best concentrate
on steadily hammering away

successCondition:

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Lightning Strikes the Tower
description:
A mythical Kirin has been
spotted at a Tower located
in an uncharted land. The
Tower can only be accessed
when the climate is just
right. In other words, now
is the time!

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ The Eldest of Dragons
description:
Curious reports reach us of
a moving mountain in the
mysterious hunting grounds
around the Tower. If our
suspicions are correct, this
may spell serious trouble.
Investigate these reports
and, if necessary, take
matters into your own hands.

charged strikes bypass any
and all defenses. Please be
careful.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Under the Crystal's Spell
description:
There has been an unusually
large amount of Aqra Vashim
hatchlings this year. This
could be a chance to strike
it big! Its resilience stems
from its bodily fluid, which
some think can grant eternal
youth. So... wanna get rich?

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Nightmare
description:
We've received reports of
Aberrant Monsters showing
up in various locales.
They may look the same, but

still shrouded in mystery.
Go out and investigate.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ One Shot, One Kill?
description:
We've confirmed reports
of an extremely powerful
Bulldrome in the swamps.
Head out and eliminate it
ASAP! Do not underestimate
it. You WILL regret it!

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Gypceros of the Marsh
description:

up in various locales.
They may look the same, but

successCondition:

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Ancient Hymn
description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
score...

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Red and Blue Horrors
description:
This Quest is aimed at elite
hunters. A rambunctious band
of wyverns are running riot
in the Arena, grouped round
an Aberrant Velocidrome and
Iodrome. To suppress these
troublemakers, you'll need
to set your sights on these
two beasts.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Amber Assault
description:
This Quest is aimed at elite
hunters. A pair of Aberrant
Gendromes have been sighted
in the Desert. They are very
aggressive, so proceed with
extreme caution, and try
to take out a pair of them.
If that's too tall an order,
try bagging just the one.
successCondition:
Hunt one of the target
monsters

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Enchanting Bloodstone
description:
According to ancient texts,
there exists a subspecies of
the Aqra Vashim, called the
Aqra Jebia. The fact that no
document depicts it without
its tail speak volumes about
its stregnth. Ambition can
sure be fatal...

description:
Listen to my tale! I found a
vast forest in an unexplored
region. No sooner did I set
foot in it than I faced a
huge swarm of Vespoids. I 
escaped with my life, but I
left my precious belongings.
Won't someone chase that
hideous herd away for me?

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Hornetaur Outbreak!
description:
No sooner had that wretched
swarm disappeared than I was
up to my eyes in a horrible
horde of Hornetaurs. My
precious belongings are
still there. Won't someone
get rid of those beasts?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Harbingers of Horror
description:
The Tower appears to have
been overrun by Remobra.
These beasts are known as
harbingers of calamity, so
the Guild cannot sit idly
by. Investigate the
situation, and slay 8
Remobra while you're at it!

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ The Great Sprouting Forest
description:
As hunters rise up the
ranks, they tend to head
out on hunt after hunt
without taking time to rest.
We hope that heading out
to the Great Forest this
time will be a welcome
break from the norm.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Canyon Specialities
description:
You're sure to find items
the like of which you've
never seen in the wilderness
of the Canyons. Really
gets the old heart racing,
doesn't it? I'd strongly
recommend you head out on
a little expedition...
successCondition:

or Subquest A or B

description:

obtain one ultra-rare beak
from a bird wyvern... The
Golden Trophy would be mine!
I'm willing to bet my entire
collection here! Capture the
funkiest-looking one you can
find! Make sure to use the
right weapon too. We can't
risk damaging the goods!
successCondition:
Capture the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B

description:
Fins are the future of fine
dining, and I need to get
myself a sample right away. 
Please use the weapons I
provide and hunt a Plesioth.
You're most welcome to the
leftovers. I'm positively
slavering at the thought...
successCondition:

or complete Subquest A or B

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ The Advent of Thunder
description:
The wild Canyon, long seen
as a worthless wasteland,
turned out to be the habitat
of the elusive Belkuros.
Boasting an elder dragon's
strength, it represents a
chance for hunters to show
what they've really got.

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Spring Thunder
description:
Veteran hunters have been
returning in their droves
nursing bloodied noses and
bruised pride, courtesy of
the Belkuros. To prevent
further mishaps, we've
prepared some special
Supply Items, so use
them wisely...

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Bolt From the Blue
description:
More hunters have beat hasty
retreats in the face of the
Belkuros. We hope to learn
a great deal more about this
bellicose beast soon, but
till then, be very careful.
We will naturally provide
more Supply Items this time.

description:

of the Public Tavern. We've
provided a lovely, quiet
area for you to gather items
to your heart's content.
Enjoy!

title: ≪Frontier Quest≫ To Victory and Beyond
description:
Attention all hunters!
The Guild's Central Council
is mobilizing its forces
against the Akantor. The
beast has been pushed back
to the Volcano, but a brave
hunter needs to step up and
take it down.

title: ≪Elder Dragon Quest≫ Showdown at Castle Schrade!
description:
The mythical black dragon
has been spotted in Castle
Schrade. Legends say that
this beast will bring
calamity and chaos to the
entire world. You must
make a stand to prevent
this prophecy from being
fulfilled.

title: ≪Elder Dragon Quest≫ Red Rage Pursuit
description:
Fatalis, the black dragon of
legend, is holed up deep in
a volcanic lair where no man
has ever set foot. We cannot
afford to leave it to its
nefarious devices or it will
surely spell disaster for
the entire world. You must
make a stand against it.

title: ≪Elder Dragon Quest≫ Old Fatalis
description:
A beast that is not referred
to in any of our official
literature has been sighted
in the mysterious Tower.
Could this really be the
Ancestral Dragon whose name
has been fearfully whispered
through the ages?

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Aberrant Espinas Research
description:
In order to investigate the
ecology of Aberrant flying
wyverns, we need samples of

Capturing them would allow

directly. Could you do that
for me? How about I reward
you with... the monster's
bodily fluids?
successCondition:

damage the specified parts

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ The Avatar of Gluttony
description:
峡谷に呑竜が現れたようね…。
呑竜には、特に欲される素材
もないから、いつもならギル
ドも狩猟手配はしないのだけ
れど、今回は、ある筋からの
依頼があるので、特別に支給
品付きで狩猟を発注するわ…。
有効に使うことね…。

description:
Whenever you get a hankering
for Pawprint Coins, come to
the Canyon with a Completion
Ticket. And come alone. I
await your visit...

description:
I was heading back from
the Canyon when a gang
of fiendish Felynes and
malicious Melynxes struck.
At this rate, I'll never
deliver these goods. Help
me out and I'll give you a
ticket you can trade for
Pawprint Coins.

description:
Listen, no one's going to
save your backside if you
mess up. You know what I'm
asking for, now go out and
get it. And go alone. I'm
not having groups ganging up
and plotting against me...

description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. This time
you'll be facing a team of
Hermitaurs and Blangongas.
Your job is to slay 20
Hermitaurs, but there's a
great reward for anyone who
takes both parties out.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Toxic Arena
description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. Surrounded by
venomous threats striking
from surface and air, only
the most courageous souls
will be able to survive
this challenge.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Lynian Feast
description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. The horde of
Shakalakas awaiting you
would daunt all but the
hardiest hunter. If you feel
confident you can take them
out, step into the Arena.

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The Wyvern Monarchy
description:
For eons the Rathalos and
Rathian have ruled land and
air respectively. No one who
takes on these regal beasts
should do it without being
aware that it could be their
last battle. Be aware that
you can only lay one Shock
Trap and one Pitfall Trap.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Venom meets Hypnosis
description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. This deadly
double act of wyverns
symbolizes the twin threats
of hypnosis and deadly
venom. Avoid their assaults
and use the Supply Items
to turn the tables.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Tigrex Terror
description:
We've received an SOS from
Hunters who were ambushed by
two Tigrexes. If you think
you're up to the task, head
there to take on this twin
threat and save the besieged
hunters.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Tigrex Threat
description:
We're received an SOS from
an expeditionary force of
hunters who set out to face
the Tigrex threat. It looks
like the dual assault proved
too much. Time is of the
essence -- get out there and
save them!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Jungle Wyvern Research
description:
I've got a fine mission for
you. Strap on all your gear
and take aim at the wyverns
of the world. Rookie hunters
will find this a bit of a
handful, but I've got some
heavy-duty equipment for
you, so try to get to grips
with all your weaponry.
successCondition:

Felynes & Melynxes! At this

make that delivery! Help me
out and I will give you a
Completion Ticket. You can
use it to get your hands on
some Pawprint Coins!

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Dreaming of Pawprint Coins
description:
I'm in trouble! A Shogun
Ceanataur happens to be
RIGHT where I was supposed
to make a delivery! Help me
out, will you? I will give
you a Completion Ticket as
thanks. You can use it to
get some Pawprint Coins!

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ The Hunt for Pawprint Coins
description:
I'm one step away from the
Canyon, but there's a Yian
Garuga in the way, and I
can't go any further! Help
me out, will you? I will
give you a Completion Ticket
as thanks. You can use it
to get some Pawprint Coins!

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Gold Pawprint Coins
description:
Hey! Thanks again for that
other time. If it's Pawcoins
you want, I'm afraid you're
going to have to come visit
me in the Canyon. Just make
sure you've got the ticket.
I'll be waiting for you!

prepared a canyon area for
you to explore. Just be
aware that some of the high
ground is still off limits.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Heroic Gray Wolf
description:
A skin-crawling howling has
been echoing round the caves
in the swamp. We believe it
to be a gray fanged beast
known as the Kamu Orgaron.
We would like to do further
research, and would
be grateful if you could
assist us...

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ The Noble White Wolf
description:
A skin-crawling howling has
been echoing round the caves
in the swamp. We believe it
to be a white fanged beast
known as the Nono Orgaron.
We would like to do further
research, and would
be grateful if you could
assist us...

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Sakura
description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Black Horns
description:
A Diablos has been sighted,
its black body striking any
who see it dumb with horror.
There is believed to be only
one, so any capable hunter
should be able to deal with
it. But if you take victory
for granted, you may be in
for a rude awakening.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Master the Flash Bomb
description:
You'll have nothing to fear
once you've mastered the art
of flinging a Flash Bomb in
front of a monster's eyes
and blinding them with a
powerful flash of light.
Flash Bombs can be found in
the Supply Box, so feel free
to use them at will.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Blue Yian Kut-Ku Sighted
description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. A
Yian Kut-Ku normally has a
pink body, but this one is
rumored to be blue. Could be
an intriguing subspecies...

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Sakura
description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Hunting in an Arctic Land
description:
Don't forget to pack some
Hot Drinks before heading
to the Arctic Ridge. Why
not get acclimatized to the
frosty slopes by slaying
Popos before taking on the
Bulldrome?
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The Red Shadow
description:
A red shadow's been sighted
slithering through the snow.
It's sure to be a Red Khezu.
The Blangos are searching
for food together in packs,
so take care not to run into
both beasts together.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ The White Shadow
description:
Khezu spend their larval
stage entirely underground,
so their sense of smell is
believed to be superior to
their eyesight. If the hunt
runs into trouble, trade the
Khezu Whelps in the ground
with the Veggie Elder and
deliver what he gives you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
The Arctic Ridge is overrun
with countless Blango this
season. Acting on the orders
of their leader, Blangonga,
they attack in packs. Don't
let them surround you.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Blangonga is the ruler of
the Arctic Ridge, and will
attack anyone who strays
onto its turf. Also, a rare
breed of Velociprey has come
in order to nest. They won't
want you touching their
eggs...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Lord of the Beasts
description:
Hunting the Iodrome in the
Volcano may well prove to
be a headache. When its
health is low, it has a
nasty habit of fleeing to
an inhospitable spot where
your health will be drained.
The trick is to not to let
it escape.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
If you plan to go after the
Basarios, keep a careful eye
on the rocky regions, since
it will often try to blend
into the terrain. If your
mind is set on mining, then
be sure to gather some Coal.
It's an excellent energy
source.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Trap Lurking in the Rock
description:
The Basarios eats ore to
grow, so its outer shell
can often contain the stuff.
Destroy its body parts and
you may save yourself the
trouble of having to mine.
Two stones, one bird!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Infernal Overlord
description:
Owing to a diet heavy in
ore and coal, the Gravios
boasts an incredibly hard
outer shell that takes
seriously robust weapons to
penetrate. If you're not
having any luck, you can
always try sneaking some
Powderstones instead...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ A Subspecies Clad in Black
description:
A Black Gravios, stained by
volcanic smoke and ash, has
appeared. One look at it
will make your blood curdle.
Still, if it's just a wyvern
encased in armor, surely
you just need to smash that
armor...

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. Should
you have trouble with the
hunt, try focusing on the
Remobra to get valuable
food ingredients instead.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Shogun of Sky and Earth
description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. This is
also the season when you'll
find large numbers of young
Ceanataurs in the Volcano.
Beware of their sharp claws.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Part Break: Wyvern Hardfang
description:
Here at the Mezeporta Clan
Association, we make it an
effort to reward hunters who
excel at breaking Aberrant
monster parts. Complete the
Quest to obtain a rare mate-
rial! Be advised that the
ticket used to initiate the
Quest will be lost upon
departure.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B

description:

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Winner's Coin Exchange
description:
I heard there's a collector
of VS Tickets residing in
the Jungle who'll trade them
for Winner's Coins. If it's
true, this tip is gold dust.
Those coins don't grow on
trees, you know.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Angler's Path: Rookie
description:
Fishing is a solitary
pursuit that requires
patience and dedication.
Your job this time is to
catch a Plesioth and
deliver 10 small fish
prints. Be sure to reel
in the Plesioth without
capturing it.
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ The Angler's Path: Reel Pro
description:
Fishing is a solitary
pursuit that requires
patience and dedication.
As a reward, you will
receive materials that
serve as proof of your
mastery. Be sure to reel
in the Green Plesioth
without capturing it.
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Green Plesioth is hunted

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Harvest Mining - Part 1
description:
You've come a long way,
haven't you? Hunting is
great, but mining is fun
too! How about you give
it a shot? I want you to
collect a lot of specific
ores. You'll get yourself
a special reward if you do.

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Harvest Gathering - Part 2
description:
Back at it gathering today?
Instead of worrying about
tools, you want to focus on
getting new armor, right?
Well, I've got another favor
to ask. It might be a bit
harder than last time, but
please do your best. It'll
be worth it.

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Harvest Gathering - Part 1
description:
Good day, nice to meet you.
Have you been gathering out
on a hunt? I think it's high
time you showed us how far
you've come. Naturally, you
will be handsomely rewarded.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Harvest Gathering - Part 2
description:
Back at it gathering today?
Instead of worrying about
tools, you want to focus on
getting new armor, right?
Well, I've got another favor
to ask. It might be a bit
harder than last time, but
please do your best. It'll
be worth it.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Harvest Mining - Finale
description:
Time for my final request.
"Are you going to ask me to
go mining again?" -- No, all
I want you to do is exchange
the coins you've obtained so
far. By the way, I've never
had Khezu Ice Cream... Think
you could help with that?

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Harvest Gathering - Finale
description:
Time for my final request.
Although...giving you the
final coin just like that
would be anticlimactic...
I want you to fetch me a
Carnivore Egg. They're too
heavy for me to carry them
myself.

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ And Thus, The Harvest Begins
description:
You've completed the two
master's requests! Your
reward will be a set of
coins used to craft a
certain piece of armor.
Oh yeah, I'm all out of
rock salt, could you go
get me some while you're
at it?

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Golden Dash
description:
After years of seeking, we
reached the Tower, where
no explorer ever set foot
and survived. There we were
confronted by a gold dragon
that lashed us with powerful
light. I just hope that our
words will serve as a stark
warning of what lies ahead.

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Silver Glide
description:
After years of seeking, we
reached the Tower, where
no explorer ever set foot
and survived. There we were
assailed by a silver dragon
that lashed us with powerful
light. I just hope that our
words will serve as a stark
warning of what lies ahead.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Taming the Tigrex
description:
You must've heard about the
unusual wyvern sighted not
so long ago. I've heard it's
form is that of the primeval
wyvernkind, and I must make
it my own. It may not be
standard practice at this
level, but I'll provide some
Supply Items to help you.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Platinum Peaks
description:
Among the frosty peaks,
fanged beasts of gold and
white are said to gather.
No such event has ever been
verified, but it has passed
down through hunter lore.
It's a rumor that gets the
hearts of hardcore hunters
racing.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Red Rage
description:
The Khezu is a prime example
of the variations that occur
within a single monster type
and is easier to find than
some other unusual beasts.
Well, you may not be able to
follow my complex analysis,
but you're surely able to go
out and get those Khezu!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Twin White Shadows
description:
Ever seen a Khezu in the
flesh? It's my idea of a
perfectly-formed beast.
That flavor, that juicy
meat... Umm. Anyway. You
couldn't slay a couple of
them for me, could you?

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Pink Rathian Hunt-a-thon!
description:
Curious reports are coming
in of Rathians descending on
the Desert. Taking on one is
hard enough, so facing them
one after another will be
a true trial. If you seek
rare items or just want to
test your mettle, take up
the challenge!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Speed Star
description:
The Guild urgently requests
that its Guild Flags take
pride of place on the summit
of the Arctic Ridge. Now,
you won't get far clad in
heavy gear like that. Supply
Items have been prepared, so
you won't need to pack any
other stuff.

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ Shadow of the Hills
description:
A Kut-Ku is menacing the
Verdant Hills just as a
convoy of the traders I
lead is passing through.
I need you to take care
of it fast. You'll need
to capture it, as any blood
spilled will cause other
wyverns to flock to the
scene.

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Glinting Gold
description:
A Canyon Research Team has
been attacked by a Rajang.
We need you to suppress the
beast. Too easy even in that
harsh environment, huh? OK,
for research purposes, let's
limit the weapons you can
use, and have you aim for
specific body parts, too.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Canyon Cacophony
description:
A Canyon Research Team has
returned after a savage
enemy assault. The injuries
sustained suggest a Tigrex.
For research purposes, we'd
like to limit the range of
weapons at your disposal,
and have you damage specific
body parts.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Canyon Blasting
description:
A Canyon Research Team has
witnessed a huge explosion
caused by a Flaming Espinas.
For research purposes, we're
limiting the range of
weapons at your disposal,
and would ask that you try
to aim for specific body
parts.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Canyon Inferno
description:
A pair of Raths has been
spotted in the Canyon. Our
research requires that
they're brought back alive,
so you'll need to capture
them. We will need most of
the items from the beasts,
but you can keep some, and
any Canyon specialties.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Angler's Path: Small Fry
description:
Fishing is a solitary
pursuit that requires
patience and dedication,
but it's an important
part of being a real Hunter.
Want to become a maestro of
the angling arts? Then get
out there and catch me
10 Speartunas!

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Pawprint Coins: Gold 1
description:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

description:
I often hear hunters whine
about Aberrant Monsters, and
how hard it is to get your
hands on their sacs. Well,
that's where I come in! All
you've got to do is capture
the monster. I've sprinkled
in some Subquests to make
your life easier, too. Good
luck!
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B

title: ≪Premium Quest≫ Hunt the Congalala (2P)
description:
We've prepared the following
Quest for a party of 1 to 2
hunters. Hunt the specified
Low Rank monster to obtain a
large amount of HRP, as well
as Porta Tickets.

title: ≪Premium Quest≫ Hunt the Congalala (4P)
description:

Quest for a party of 3 to 4
hunters. Hunt the specified
Low Rank monster to obtain a
large amount of HRP, as well
as Porta Tickets.

title: ≪Premium Quest≫ A.Hypnocatrice Arena (2P)
description:
We've prepared the following
Quest for a party of 1 to 2
hunters. Hunt the specified
Aberrant monster to obtain a
large amount of HRP, as well
as Porta Tickets.
successCondition:

or complete Subquest A

description:

Aberrant monster to obtain a

successCondition:

or complete Subquest A

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Duragaua Assault
description:
An ice-wielding wyvern has
been spotted at the hidden
part of the Ancient Tower.
The Guild has dubbed it the
"Duragaua" and is currently
researching its ecology.
Information on it remains
scarce, and we'd like to
ask for your help with the
investigation.

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ The Frozen Tower
description:
According to our expedition
team, the Tower holds yet
another secret -- a secret,
secluded area. Despite the
Tower's abundant Rathalos
population, rumors say that
it is inhabited by something
else entirely -- a wyvern
clad in frozen armor. We
need you to investigate.

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Darkness Unleashed
description:
We've received reports of
a new flying wyvern in the
Arctic Ridge. According to
witness reports, it bears
a striking resemblance to
the Belkuros. However, it
does not command lightning.
Perhaps it's a subspecies?
Go out and investigate.

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Part Break: Wyvern Cortex
description:
Here at the Mezeporta Clan
Association, we make it an
effort to reward hunters who
excel at breaking Aberrant
monster parts. Complete the
Quest to obtain a rare mate-
rial! Be advised that the
ticket used to initiate the
Quest will be lost upon
departure.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B

description:

Association, we make it an

successCondition:

title: ≪Highlands Survey≫ The Brute of the Highlands
description:
A new, powerful monster has
been found in the Highlands.
Its fierce appearance has
earned it the nickname of
"Barbarian". We'd like to
ask you to hunt it. What do
you say? Aren't you curious
what hunting in a new land
is like?

title: ≪Highlands Survey≫ Grenzebul Gone Berserk
description:
The "Brute of the Highlands"
has been officially dubbed
as the "Grenzebul" by the
Guild. Extremely powerful,
this violent flying wyvern
has perfectly adapted to
the unique environment of
the Highlands, making it a
formidable threat. Best of
luck, hunters.

title: ≪Extra Quest≫ A Tour of the Canyon (HR-2)
description:
It's what you've all been
waiting for! Yes, it's time
for an Extra Quest, courtesy
of the Public Tavern! We've
prepared a canyon area for
you to explore. The high
ground has been declared
safe, so you're free to
explore it to your heart's
content.

title: ≪Extra Quest≫ A Tour of the Canyon (HR-2)
description:

title: ≪Highlands Survey≫ Highlands Specialties (D)
description:
I'd like to task you with
surveying the Highlands.
Unexplored lands mean only
one thing. You guessed it,
new and never-before-found
materials. Excited? I know
you are. Go out there and
get it done!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Highlands Survey≫ Highlands Specialties (N)
description:

successCondition:

title: ≪Highlands Survey≫ Highlands Wildlife (D)
description:
There's nothing quite like

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Violent Blues
description:
We've confirmed reports of
Aberrant Velocidrome in the
Jungle. These individuals
are extremely aggressive.
If hunting two proves too
difficult, eliminating even
one will suffice.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monsters,
or complete Subquest A

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Vivid Reds
description:
We've confirmed reports of
several Aberrant Iodrome in
the Marshlands. They are
extremely ferocious indivi-
duals, so please hunt two
of them if possible. If that
proves too difficult, just
one of them will do.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monsters,
or complete Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Egg Hunt: Yian Kut-Ku
description:
Hm? Goocoo Eggs? Ah right,
I lost one of them when I
was attacked by a monster
in the Jungle. It *really*
ruffled my feathers. If a
Yian Kut-Ku got it... you
might be able to snatch it
by startling it with a loud
noise. If you get it back,
it's all yours.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Egg Hunt: Congalala
description:
I've got a favor to ask.
A Congalala caught me by
surprise in the Marshlands
and stole my eggs! And not
just normal ones, either!
Goocoo Eggs! Get it back,
and it's all yours. Though
you'll have to pry it from 
its tail...

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Egg Hunt: Daimyo Hermitaur
description:
Goocoo Eggs? I bought a few
of 'em alongside other eggs,
but apparently the shipment 
has gone missing somewhere
in the Desert. I've all but
given up on it, but if you
find it, it's all yours. If
a Daimyo Hermitaur stole it,
it might just drop the egg
when switching areas...

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Goocoo Search Party
description:
Your feathered friend has
run off somewhere... You
want it back, right? Don't
forget your bond! If mew
look hard enough, you'll
purr-obably find some of
its memories around the
Jungle! That should do it!
I'm sure it's only a meow
away...

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Stolen Drawings
description:
It's a cat-astrophe! They
stole my drawings! I worked
my paws off all night, but
they've taken them all! It
must've been these thieving
Melynx! Mew've got to get
them back! Even if they're
in pieces!

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Stolen Drawings - Reprise
description:
Simply prepawsterous!
They've done it again! 
I worked my paws off all
night, purr-eparing new
designs for the Goocoo and
I've been robbed again!
Hunter, please, mew've got
to get them back!

title: ≪Special Event Quest≫ Annual Benefits 4
description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Lava Sanctuary and deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets IV!
These can be used to craft
exclusive Dual Blades, known
as the "Aqra Ein"!

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Egg Hunt: Basarios
description:
I've lost a Wyvern Egg, but
what's worse is that I lost
a Goocoo Egg too! You've got
to get it back! If Basarios
snatched it, try scaring it
out of its wits while its
hidden in the ground or
asleep! That should do it!

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Egg Hunt: Tigrex
description:
A Tigrex has been spotted in
the Arctic Ridge holding an
egg in its mouth. Was it a
Wyvern Egg, a Carnivore Egg,
or perhaps...a Goocoo Egg? 
Please investigate. You can
keep whatever you find. You
might be able to snatch it
by getting Tigrex stuck in
a wall...

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Mighty Vespoid Outbreak!?
description:
I've got used to the Great
Forest. The Vespoids too,
even large swarms. But that
one felt... different. Could
it have been one of those
Mighty varieties...? Not a
chance? Anyway, help me out
here! I saw a Hypnocatrice
too, so be careful.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Mighty Hornetaur Outbreak!?
description:
Vespoids and Hornetaurs?
Not a problem. Nothing in
the Great Forest could faze
me anymore. Except one of
those giant swarms... It
was nothing like I'd ever
seen before... Do whatever
it takes to get rid of it
and get my supplies back.
And watch out for Rathian!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Capture Craving
description:
ヨウ！俺だよ！
毎日捕獲してるかい？捕獲は
ハンターの醍醐味のひとつだ。
今回は密林のモンスター共を
ドスンドスンと捕獲してきて
くんな。多少だが、特殊な報
酬も用意したから頑張れよ。
討伐したら当然失敗となるぜ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Bulldrome is slain

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Blast Off!
description:
沼地で２頭のフルフル変種が
暴れているらしい。
フルフルといえば炎だよな。
そう！ガンランスであいつら
をドカンドカンと撃ち倒して
くるんだ！やり遂げれば、
俺が以前剥ぎ取ってきた皮等、
特別な報酬を出すぞ！

title: ≪Tidal Island Survey≫ The Tropical Fanged Beast
description:
熱帯の潮島を調査したところ、
未知の牙獣種が発見された
ようです。調査団によると、
上から襲ってきたとか、大き
い個体と、小さい個体がいた
とか、何かから毒を受けたと
か…。え、よくわからない？
そうですね、行って確かめて
はいかがでしょう？

title: ≪Tidal Island Survey≫ Leaping Guardian
description:
潮島で新たに発見された、
牙獣種≪ゴゴモア≫の狩猟
依頼です。熱帯の潮島という
慣れない環境での狩りとは
思いますが、こういう時こそ
ハンターさんたちの腕の見せ
どころではないでしょうか。
頑張ってきてください！

title: ≪Tidal Island Survey≫ T.Island Specialties (LR)
description:
熱帯の≪潮島≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

title: ≪Tidal Island Survey≫ T.Island Specialties (HR)
description:
熱帯の≪潮島≫。

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ White Stub Exchange (HR1)
description:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「怯まずの実」や「使い捨て
高級耳栓」など、便利なアイ
テムが手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を
入手したら、ぜひ来てくれ！

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ White Stub Exchange (HR100)
description:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「剛種チケット」が、
手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を
入手したら、ぜひ来てくれ！

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ White Stub Exchange (HR500)
description:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「ＨＣチケット」が、
手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Unknown Usurper
description:
現在、謎のモンスターが、
密林にいるとの報告が
ありました。
未だ種を特定できず、
多くが謎のままですが、
新種の可能性があります。
非常に獰猛とのことなので、
危険な調査依頼となりますが、
よろしくお願いします。

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫Abiorg Assault
description:
密林で確認された≪獰竜≫
ですが、今までメゼポルタ
周辺には生息していなかった
獣竜種であることが
判明しました。
ハンターズギルドでは、
これを≪アビオルグ≫と
名付けたようです。
更なる調査をお願いします。

title: ≪Tidal Island Survey≫ The Island Tycoon
description:
One of our surveyors has
reportedly heard a strange
noise in the caverns below
the Tidal Island. Others
have reported seeing moving
rocks, and are very worried.
We may be dealing with an
unknown monster. We need
you to investigate.

title: ≪Tidal Island Survey≫ Guardian of the Abyss
description:
潮島の洞窟で新たな甲殻種が
発見されたそうです。
ハンターズギルドでは、
多殻蟹≪タイクンザムザ≫と
名付けました。
どうやら潮島で独自の進化を
遂げた甲殻種のようで、
全く形の違う２本の鎌が
特徴であるとのことです。
更なる調査をお願いします。

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ First Steps!
description:
うむ、我輩だ。
このクエストでは操作タイプ
の決定と、必要最低限のアド
バイス。そして我輩と共に
≪ゴゴモア≫を狩猟するぞ！
このクエストは特別に、失敗
条件を設けていない。だから
倒すまで終わらせないぞ！
よし、頑張るぞー！

title: ≪Rookie Quest≫ First Steps! - Reprise
description:
うむ、我輩だ！
このクエストは、ハンターが
初めてメゼポルタに来たら
必ず体験してもらったものと
同じ内容になっている。
しかし！報酬面は安く、ター
ゲットである≪ゴゴモア≫の
強さは強くなっているぞ。
復習も兼ねてトライだ！

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Heaven's Gate
description:
閉ざされた秘境に足を踏み入
れるには、資格が必要となる。
その資格とは≪秘境セット≫
に他ならない。
天国の門を開き、その資格を
手にした者は、閉ざされた
秘境の奥に、幸いを見つける
ことだろう･･･。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Open Sesame
description:
天に選ばれた者のみが、足を
踏み入れることを許される地、
秘境…。
忘れられた彼の地をくまなく
探索した者は、世にも珍しき
物を手にすることができるだ
ろう…。

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ A Threat Unknown
description:
We've received reports of
an Abiorg rampaging in the
Marshlands. There is still
much we do not know about
it, but the investigation
is slowly progressing. We
would like to ask for your
help in the matter.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Tyrannical Incursion
description:
We've confirmed reports of
an Abiorg in the Marshlands.
This is horrible news. The
swamps are often frequented
by rookies. Countless lives
are at stake. Now's the time
to show what you're made of.

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Fiery Face-Off
description:
火山で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Sandy Showdown
description:
眠鳥と砂竜が大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Drill!
description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！砂漠で２頭の鳥竜と
魚竜の群れを狩猟し、仕上げ
に、洞窟より草食竜の卵を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Volcano Drill!
description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！火山で岩竜の狩猟と、
大量のランゴスタの討伐。
そして熱い熱い火薬岩１個を
運んできて納品するんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Swamp Drill!
description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！沼地で桃毛獣と、鳥竜
の群れを狩猟し、仕上げに、
洞窟より灰水晶の原石２個を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Arctic Drill!
description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！雪山で２頭の大猪と、
雪獅子の子分達の狩猟。そし
て、支給品ボックスのギルド
フラッグを山頂に立てるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Jungle Drill!
description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！密林の砂浜や島で盾蟹
と桃毛獣の群れを狩猟し、
仕上げに、洞窟より肉食竜の
卵を持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Fermium: Aqra Vashim
description:
Ancient notes about crafting
techniques, believed to have
been lost to time, have been
found on monsters in various
locales! If you happen to
get your hands on one, bring
it to me at once! I'll show
you what a real man can do!

title: ≪Special Event Quest≫ Annual Benefits 5
description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Aqra Vier and deliver one
Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets V!
These can be used to craft a
special Long Sword, known as
the "Revered Talonsword"!

title: ≪Highlands Survey≫ Crystal Clear Revelation
description:
Our investigators claim to
have found a new monster in
the Highlands. It's said to
have a long neck and tail,
supple limbs, and no wings.
Its back is extremely tough,
and appears to be covered in
crystals. There's still much
we do not know. Be careful.

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Fireworks Festa!
description:
Hey! I've got some special
gear for 'ya. Blast away at
those monsters and show them
who's boss! I've prepared a
set of special rewards too!
Have fun!

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Great Fireworks Festa!
description:
Hey! I've got some special
gear for 'ya. Blast away at
those monsters and show them
who's boss! I've prepared a
set of special rewards too!
Have fun!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Rathian Hunt-a-thon!
description:
We've received a one of a
kind report about a group
of Rathian descending upon
the Desert! This Quest's
shaping up to be a hunting
marathon! If you're in need
of Rathian parts, or simply
seek a challenge, give it a
try!
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Egg Dream: Desert
description:
Spring has come! The stage
has been set! Can you handle
the desert sun? Countless
riches await you! If you're
looking to make it big, step
right up!

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Beastly Procession
description:
A Blangonga and a Rajang
have been spotted at the
Ridge. This is quite...
unprecedented. Focus on
hunting the Blango boss
and breaking its parts.
As for Rajang... if you
could spare the time...
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Marine Blessings
description:
I was out fishing, having
the time of my life, but
then a Daimyo Hermitaur and
a Plesioth came and ruined
everything! I'll give you
whatever I have left, just
get rid of that crab! I'll
handle the Plesioth. Though
don't let me stop you from
fishing it out.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Argenite Sword & Shield
description:
Looking for a one-handed
Sword? I've got you! Ever
heard of Argenite? Just one
thing... The ore used to
make it is incredibly rare,
and is usually surrounded
by some nasty monsters.
Do your best and I'll take
it from there!

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Argenite Dual Blades
description:
Looking for Dual Blades?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!
