usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Argenite Lance
description:
Looking for a Lance?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Argenite Gunlance
description:
Looking for a Gunlance?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Argenite Light Bowgun
description:
Looking for a Light Bowgun?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Argenite Heavy Bowgun
description:
Looking for a Heavy Bowgun?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Argenite Bow
description:
Looking for a Bow?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ The Secret of the Raths
description:
I have studied the Raths for
many years, and my research
is all but complete. Now all
that's left for me to do, is
to study the Aberrant ones!
With that my book will be
ready! I need you to capture
both of them for me. If you
do, I'll gift you a copy.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Sandy Surprise
description:
俺の角笛が欲しいってか？
うーん、金や物じゃ渡せねぇ
なぁ。どうやらいま砂漠に、
この角笛、そして俺の顔の
傷と因縁がある連中がいる
らしいから、あいつらを狩猟
して力を示してくれたら
やってもいいぞ。
successCondition:
Hunt one of the target
monsters

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ A Battle on Two Fronts
description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
score...

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Insult to Injury
description:
I think the Arctic Ridge may
have finally broken me. I've
been a hunter for many, many
years, but I've never felt
this horrified. I thought I
wouldn't make it. I remember
seeing a strange black metal
on my way back, but I had no
chance to look into it.

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ The Rookie Carver's Trial
description:
師匠から急な命令があってね。
一人前の剥ぎ取り職人なら、
鎧竜変種からその尾骨を剥ぎ
取れるんで、それを取って来
て見せろとさ。捕獲と、尻尾
の切断はハンターに依頼して
いいらしいから、なんとか頼
むよ。尾骨が取れたら、師匠
に見せたあとにあげるからさ。
successCondition:
Capture the target monster,
and break the specified part

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Lava Dancers
description:
The sight of living beings
fighting for their lives...
What a thrill! How about
this -- Head to the Volcano
and hunt down a Shogun
Ceanataur. I shall reward
you with a precious, jeweled
egg. They say that there's a
fanged beast in the area,
but you can leave it be...

title: ≪Canyon Survey≫ Wild Dark Dancers
description:
峡谷の絶景を一度見たくて、
足を踏み入れたら、凶暴な
モンスターに遭遇してしまい
ました。そちらの呼び方です
と、黒狼鳥と金獅子でしょう
か。一人では太刀打ちできな
いので、先へ進めず仕方なく
戻ってきました。どうか彼ら
を退治してほしいです。

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Mystery of the Lost Ruins
description:
I've heard this rumor about
ancient ruins hidden in the
Marshlands. I went to go and
check them out myself, but
an Aqra Jebia stood in my
way. Think y'could get rid
of it for me? I'll give ya'
a part of the artifacts I
find as thanks.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Red Guard
description:
A certain traveler really
wants to visit the Jungle.
According to their servant,
the place is swarming with
Daimyo Hermitaur, and they
want them gone. Apparently
they're offering a special
reward... Interested?

title: ≪Arena Battle≫ Blue with a Hint of Blue
description:
Ah, right, that painting the
Guild ordered... Yes, yes,
of course. All that's left
is the Velocipreys. Oh, if
only anyone was willing to
help me capture their raw
ferocity... I'm sure the
Guild would reward them
handsomely...

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ The Hymn of the Hills
description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
second part...
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Honest Hammering
description:
What, you want this piece
of junk? It says something
about upgrading armor. I
could do it, but not for a
wimp like you... How bout'
ya get some more experience
first. Forging's all about
fire, a bit of clink, and a
whole lotta clang. Got it?
successCondition:
Hunt one of the target
monsters

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Proof of Patience
description:
Stunning medallion, right?
If you work hard, you too
can make something like it.
Patience is a virtue for
artisans and hunters alike.
If you can show me just how
patient you really are, it's
all yours.
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Bird-brained Beatdown
description:
Aim for the head, strike,
strike, and strike again!
Those are the fundamentals
of hunting. If you want to
get your hands on this rare
bone, take my beloved gear
and bash some birds in!

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Pink & Poisonous Peril
description:
An Aberrant Gypceros and
Congalala seem to be causing
quite the ruckus around the
Jungle. Please hunt them as
soon as possible. You will
be rewarded with a special
emblem provided to us by
the Guild.

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ Verdant Hills Reprisal
description:
I was out gathering in the
Verdant Hills, when a pair
of Rathalos attacked! I've
saved my skin, but I can't
just stand by and let them
wreak havoc. Can you handle
it? I'll give ya' a Sturdy
Jawbone in return.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Dark Wolf, Dark Stars
description:
I saw it! A bona fide meteor
shower! You may be able to
find traces of them around
the Jungle. I hear there's
a Garuga in the area though,
so be careful!
successCondition:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Desert Crown
description:
I was ambushed by a color-
shifting scorpion! What's
worse, I dropped my precious
book... If you've got the
time, could you please look
for it? Still, the crystals
on that critter were one-of-
a-kind. I'd love to add some
to my costume...
successCondition:
Slay the Aqra Vashim, and
hunt the Gendrome

title: ≪Great Forest Survey≫ Hypnocatrice Hysteria
description:
Have ya' been to the Great
Forest lately? It's full of
them blue birds now, right?
Could you bring me their
feathers? What!? It's the
wrong season!? Oh well, an
orange one will do too!
Don't overthink it kiddo!
Just go!

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Black Bastion
description:
A pair of old Black Gravios
has appeared in the swamp.
Considering their age and
huge bodies... They could
probably devour all the ore
in the area! Is there any
brave soul ready to take
them out?

title: ≪Special Event Quest≫ Annual Benefits 2 (Sovereign)
description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Sovereign's Blade, deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket, and
get your hands on a set of
eleven Gratitude Tickets II!
These can be used to craft a
one-of-a-kind Lance, known
as the "Akantor Spire"!

title: ≪Special Event Quest≫ Annual Benefits 3-2
description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Akantor Warn and deliver a
Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets V!
These can be used to craft a
one-of-a-kind Hammer, known
as the "Lava Impact"!

title: ≪Special Event Quest≫ Annual Benefits 4-2
description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Great Lavasioth and deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets IV!
These can be used to craft
exclusive Dual Blades, known
as the "Aqra Ein"!

title: ≪Special Event Quest≫ Annual Benefits 5-2
description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Aqra Zehn and deliver one
Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets V!
These can be used to craft a
special Long Sword, known as
the "Revered Talonsword"!

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ Trickster
description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the Elder Dragons. It
is so rare that, even now,
many question its existence!
Trying to capture it is no
use. You'd best concentrate
on steadily hammering away
instead.

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ The Phantom Beast
description:
この地の彼方に眠る、謎多き
未開の地≪古塔≫に、幻獣≪
キリン≫が現れたようね。
古塔へはいつでも行けるわけ
ではなく、天候や気候を始め
とする環境が安定してる期間
だけ…、今しかないようね。

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Forest Gobbler
description:
謎多き狩猟地≪古塔≫にて、
山が動くとの奇妙な話が届い
ておる…。ワシの推測が的中
すれば、ちと厄介な事態にな
りそうなのじゃ。事態が暗転
する前にその真実を確かめ、
話が誠ならば討伐を頼むぞ！

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ The Ravaging Rainstorm
description:
The Kushala Daora is a
different monster from
anything you've hunted this
far. Its very presence can
transform rain into a storm.
Capturing it is a waste of
time, so concentrate on
steadily hammering away
at it instead.

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ A Jungle Veiled by Mist
description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the elder dragons.
It's almost as if the Jungle
rain is on his side, as it
grows more intense when he's
nearby. Trying to capture
him is a waste of time, so
concentrate on steadily
hammering away instead.

title: ≪Desert Survey≫ Blazing Hot Sands
description:
The Teostra is an elder
dragon said to be an avatar
of the inferno. Its ferocity
puts it in a terrifying
class all its own. Don't
even think about trying to
capture it, just hammer
away and wear it down.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Creeping Menace
description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the Elder Dragons. It
is capable of vanishing in
a flash, making it feared
even by the most elite of
hunters. Trying to capture
it is no use. Concentrate
on steadily hammering away
instead.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ A Muddy Audience
description:
The Teostra is said to be an
avatar of the inferno. Its
fiery cloak will mercilessly
sap away at your Health at
close range... You have no
hope of capturing it. Focus
on steadily wearing it down
instead.

title: ≪Ancient Tower Survey≫ Shocking Silver
description:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物ね。過酷な環境もものとも
しない適応力から、属性の類
は、ほとんど通用しないみた
いだから気をつけてね。

title: ≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫ Lord of the Storm
description:
The Kushala Daora is far
removed from any monster
you've hunted this far.
It will likely throw your
own powerlessness into
stark relief. Don't even
try to capture it, focus
on steadily wearing it
down instead.

title: ≪Volcano Survey≫ Sparks Dancing in the Blaze
description:
The Teostra is said to be an
avatar of the inferno, with
all the fire and heat of the
Volcano at its command. You
have no hope of capturing
it, so concentrate instead
on steadily hammering away.

title: ≪Marshlands Survey≫ Teostra Investigation
description:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

title: ≪Verdant Hills Survey≫ Chameleos Investigation
description:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

title: ≪Jungle Survey≫ Kushala Daora Investigation
description:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Preparation is Key
description:
腹減った…。さっき食べた
ばかりだけど、腹が減った。
悪いけど、オレにこんがり肉
を分けてくれないか？礼なら
ちゃんとするぜ。その代わり
生焼けやコゲ肉なんかじゃ、
満足しないぜ。じゃー頼んだ
よ。あぁ、腹減ったなぁ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Memories of the Exam
description:
アイツに会ったのは、公式狩
猟試験以来だったかな。しば
らく、ぬるま湯の生活に慣れ
ちまったオレもダメなんだが、
アイツは半端なしに強いぜ。
あんたも、腕試しのつもりで
行ってみたらどうだい？
ま、その腕が鈍っていなけれ
ばの話だがな。
failCondition:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ A Protection Job
description:
今回は猟団員の皆様に挑戦状
ですニャ。このクエストは、
サブターゲットにステキな報
酬を用意させていただいた
ニャ。でも、メインターゲッ
トは簡単に達成できてしまう
ので、時にはアイルーを守る
ことも必要かも知れないです
ニャ。健闘を祈りますニャ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Rajang Marathon
description:
オレは目を疑ったね。だって
あの≪ラージャン≫が２頭も
いるんだぜ？おちおち採掘な
んてしていられなかったよ。
でもさ、あの火山って、いい
採掘ポイントがいくつかある
んだよね。…なぁ、頼むから
あんた達でなんとかあいつら
をやっつけてくれないかい。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Confluence of Tigrex
description:
今回も猟団員の皆様に、クエ
ストを用意させていただいた
ニャ。今度はアイツが、２頭
同時で登場しているニャ。
サブターゲットクリアは用意
していないので、準備をしっ
かりして、猟団員の皆様で力
を合わせて頑張ってください
ニャ。健闘を祈りますニャ。

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Fungal Feud
description:
あの形…あのツヤ…あの香り
…。あんなキノコ、なかなか
お目にかかれないのに、あの
野郎ときたら、オレの目の前
でパクッと食べやがった。
そこでだ！オレが依頼するの
は、そのキノコを食べたアイ
ツ≪モス≫を倒して欲しいっ
てことだ。頼んだぜ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Noxious Nap
description:
この前、突然眠くなってきた
んで、あれっと思って辺りを
見たら≪ヒプノック≫の仕業
だったね。正直参ったよ。
おまけに≪ガブラス≫もいる
もんだから、眠るし毒だしで、
生きて帰れないかと焦ったよ。
あそこに行くんだったら気を
つけて行くんだな。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Pursuit of Power
description:
Yo! I really want to get
stronger, but I think I've
hit a wall. No matter how
hard I try, I just can't
hunt the Gypceros or the
Khezu. I'd like you to give
it a shot too! You'll see
just how hard it can really
get.

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Handle With Care!
description:
最近、卵料理に凝り始めちゃ
ってね。おかげで卵がいくら
あっても足りないんだよな。
だから頼む！オレに≪草食竜
の卵≫を６個運んできてくれ
ないか？礼は用意してあるか
ら安心してくれ。無用の長物
かもしれないがな。
successCondition:
メインターゲット、もしくは
サブターゲットＡかＢの達成

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Bright and White
description:
あんた達、雪山の採掘ポイン
トを知っているかい？なかな
かいい所あるだろ？なのによ、
オレがピッケルを使うと、必
ず奴らが来るんだよね。どう
にかならねぇかなぁ…。
あ、≪フルベビ漬け≫を納品
してくれたら、礼するぜ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Hot, Hot, Hot!
description:
おッス。今回は火山で汗をか
きながら自分自身を鍛えてい
たッス。そしたら出たッス。
正直、しんどいッス。だけど
この先に明日が見えるに違い
ないッス。なので猟団のみな
さんにも挑戦して欲しいッス。

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Dreamy Duet?
description:
今回も明るい猟団生活を送っ
てもらうために、クエストを
用意させていただいたニャ。
住む世界の異なる２頭が、大
闘技場で夢の共演ですニャ。
猟団員の皆様で、力を合わせ
て頑張ってくださいニャ。
健闘を祈りますニャ。

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Tigrex Rampage
description:
大変ですニャ！あの《ティガ
レックス》が雪山で大暴れし
ているそうですニャ！今回は
危険なので、ＨＲ７１以上の
ハンターさんにお願いしてい
るニャ。サブターゲットもあ
るので、そちらも挑戦しても
らえると嬉しいですニャ。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫
description:
おっス。今日は夜の砂漠で、
寒さに耐えながら特訓ッス。
自分で目標決めて挑んだッス
が、まだまだダメッス。この
時間以内に倒せないッス。
そこで猟団のみなさんだった
らどうかと思って依頼してみ
たッス。どうッスか？

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Today's Big Haul!
description:
I think I'm up against the
biggest hunting challenge
of my life. I mean -- two
Plesioth? In the Desert!?
I bet even you'd struggle
with this one. If you're
up for the challenge, feel
free to play it safe and
start with the Subquest.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ A Hot Date
description:
火山ってイイよね。採掘には
全く飽きない場所だよ。だけ
どさ、あのポイントには近づ
けられないんだよ。アイツが
いるからなんだよね。どうに
かしてくれねぇかなぁ…。
掘りたいんだよなぁ…。
な、頼むよ。礼はするから。
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Ready, Set, BOOM!
description:
I've just finished crafting
a special item for another
customer, but honestly, I
haven't even tried it yet.
Why don't you lot help me?
I'll leave it in the Supply
Box. Don't be fooled, it'll
be just like the real deal.
Counting on you.

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Shakalaka Shakedown
description:
こ、これは大変ですニャ！
森丘に《チャチャブー》の奴
等がたくさん来たですニャ！
しかも…あ、あの飛竜達も
大暴れしているニャ！
ここはみなさん、落ち着いて
準備してから出発してくだ
さいですニャ！
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ The Jungle's Lone Wolf?
description:
He's finally shown up.
Boldly appearing alone --
just him and me, face to
face in a true showdown.
As for how it ended... heh.
That doesn't matter. More
importantly, I'll tell you
WHERE it happened. You all
should go see it for your-
selves.

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Crabs-a-plenty
description:
Yo! I'm currently out honing
my skills in the swamp. It's
been going pretty well, but
after failing and failing...
I don't think I'm ready yet.
So I thought: "maybe a Clan
could help me out?" And...
here we are. So, how about
it?

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Long Horns?
description:
The Desert mining spots are
so good. But those horned
menaces, and their absurdly
loud roars, make it hard to
appreciate them... Can you
maybe do something about it?
I'm begging you...

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Lean, Mean & Green
description:
The Great Forest is, well...
great. Its greenery almost
feels therapeutic... but
not THAT type of greenery!
Especially the spiky kind!
That one's better off dead!
Please hunt them down for
me.
successCondition:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Rocks, Lava, Danger!
description:
I think I'm up against the
biggest hunting challenge
of my life. There's that
sneaky rock, and then that
blazing hot fish... And they
want me to hunt TWO of them?
I just can't do it... It's
hopeless! You get me, right?
Right...?

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ When the Magic Happens
description:
I saw two Hypnocatrice
wooing each other in the
Great Forest! And here I
am, still single... Blast
those da... Wait, I know!
The Forest is in danger,
yes! You need to hunt
them to keep the peace!

title: ≪Clan Quest≫ Ridge Ruckus
description:
Calm down! Listen to me!
We've received reports of
two meownsters in the Arctic
Ridge! Your targets are: The
fearsome Rajang, and a fur-
